title: Recruitment Assistant — Marketing & Creative Roles
description:
We're looking for a Recruitment Assistant who lives and breathes marketing hiring — someone who already knows where to find great Creative Strategists, Content Creators, and UGC Video Editors because they've hired for these exact roles before, ideally inside a DTC (direct-to-consumer) brand. This is not a generalist HR role and not a psychometric-testing role. We need speed, judgment, and a ready network, someone who can take a hiring need and turn it into a shortlist of vetted, portfolio-strong candidates in days, not weeks, with minimal hand-holding.



Key Responsibilities

- Sourcing & Pipeline: Own end-to-end sourcing and screening for marketing and creative roles, primarily Creative Strategist, Content Creator/Videographer, UGC Video Editor, and adjacent DTC-marketing positions (Media Buyer, Copywriter, Community Manager, etc. as needed).



- Ready Talent Pool: Tap into an existing personal network or talent pool of creatives and marketers so early-stage sourcing doesn't start from zero.



- Portfolio-Based Screening: Review portfolios, reels, and past campaign work to judge creative and technical quality — not just resumes.



- Candidate Screening: Conduct initial screening calls to assess communication, availability, rate expectations, and cultural fit for a fast-scaling eCommerce brand.



- Process Ownership: Manage candidates through a clear, fast-moving process (screen ? hiring manager interview ? offer), keeping every candidate informed without needing reminders.



- Tracker & Reporting: Maintain an organized, up-to-date candidate tracker (pipeline stage, source, notes, portfolio links) that the HR Manager can review at a glance.



- Employer Branding: Craft or adapt job ads and outreach messages that speak the language of creatives and marketers, not generic corporate copy.



- Independent Judgment: Manage multiple open roles at once, flag bottlenecks early, and suggest sourcing-channel or messaging adjustments without waiting to be told.



What We're Looking For

- Marketing-Role Hiring Experience: Solid, hands-on experience recruiting for marketing/creative roles — Creative Strategist, Content Creator, UGC Video Editor, Videographer, or similar.



- DTC/Ecommerce Brand Background: Has recruited for a direct-to-consumer eCommerce brand before and understands the pace, content volume, and creative bar that DTC marketing demands.



- Existing Candidate Pool: Comes in with a warm network or existing shortlist of creatives and marketers — not starting the search cold.



- Low-Supervision Operator: Can independently run sourcing-to-shortlist with light check-ins, not step-by-step direction.

Comfortable Judging Creative Work: Comfortable reviewing reels, TikToks, UGC samples, and ad creatives to judge quality and fit.



- Speed: Fast turnaround from job brief to first shortlist — speed is a core KPI for this role, not a bonus.



- Sourcing Tools: Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter, 
munity groups, Upwork/freelance platforms, or other channels where creative talent hangs out.



How to Apply:

Send your resume/portfolio to 
 with a subject line: Recruitment Assistant -[Years of experience as a Recruiter specifically hiring Marketing and Creative Roles]



Make sure to include your best contact number and make sure to be ready to answer a phone call.

title: Meta Ads Creative Strategist - Ecommerce
description:
About the Role

We're a fast-scaling ecommerce brand looking for an experienced Meta Ads Creative Strategist to take ownership of our paid social performance. You'll run the full creative-to-campaign loop: research the market, study competitors, develop UGC-style ads that convert, ship new creatives daily, and make the call on when and what to scale.

This is a hands-on, performance-driven role for someone who lives inside Ads Manager, knows every lever the platform offers, and treats every campaign like a science experiment.



What You'll Do

- Manage and optimize our Meta 
/Instagram) ad campaigns end-to-end

- Advice when, what, and how to scale based on performance data

- Launch new ads daily to keep the creative pipeline fresh

- Develop UGC-style ad concepts, scripts, hooks, and angles

- Run competitor research and surface winning ad trends, angles, and offers

- Conduct market research to identify new audiences, positioning, and opportunities

- Validate ad performance against KPIs and iterate ruthlessly on what works

- Apply advanced Meta ads tactics - CBO/ABO structures, audience layering, creative testing frameworks, retargeting funnels, and the latest platform updates - to keep campaigns winning

- Brainstorm and test new creative directions to break through plateaus



What We're Looking For

- 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta ad campaigns for ecommerce.

- Proven, documented track record - case studies, screenshots of Ads Manager results, ROAS/spend numbers, or client references we can verify

- Proven track record of scaling campaigns profitably

- Strong portfolio of UGC ads you've conceptualized or produced

- Deep working knowledge of Meta's algorithm, bidding strategies, campaign structures, and all the tips, tricks, and platform nuances that separate good campaigns from great ones

- Sharp eye for hooks, storytelling, and what makes an ad stop the scroll

- Self-directed, data-driven, and obsessive about creative iteration

- Excellent communication - you can explain why an ad worked, not just that it did

- Fast response time and ability to work efficiently under pressure.



Work Schedule

- 4 hours per day

- 5 days per week

- Must be available during agreed working hours.



If you are interested in applying, please start your application with the phrase:

“I’m ready to scale and yes, I saw the hamburger.”

title: Logistics Dispatcher VA (Driver dispatching)
description:
Schedule: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM Central (mid-shift coverage)

Type: Full-Time



About the Role



We run a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) operation (~40 drivers across Arkansas and West Memphis, with a Tennessee expansion coming in about 60 days) and need a Dispatcher VA to cover our mid-shift — the critical window when our first dispatcher leaves for the day. You'll handle will-calls, B-legs, and drivers traveling from farther out, keeping things running smoothly through the handoff.



This is a heavily phone-facing role. You'll be on back-to-back inbound calls, coordinating routes and schedules in real time, often with hospitals and healthcare facilities on the line.



Core Responsibilities



Dispatch and coordinate routes for our NEMT operation via our TMS — assign jobs by zone, availability, and vehicle type

Handle back-to-back inbound phone calls for scheduling and coordination

Monitor job status in real time, log proof of delivery, and close out completed jobs

Immediately escalate failed pickups/deliveries, driver no-shows, or client complaints — do not wait



During downtime: support HR by pulling applications from Indeed and assisting with driver hiring, to keep our HR team from getting overloaded

Never activate a driver in the dispatch system without confirmed clearance — wait for explicit sign-off

Keep the TMS updated in real time; stale records cause client disputes



Must-Haves



Excellent, clear spoken English is non-negotiable. This is a heavily phone-facing role and we have had to let previous VAs go specifically due to communication issues on hospital calls.

Dispatching or scheduling experience preferred

Comfortable with RingCentral (our dialer), Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace for calls



To Apply: Please include a short voice recording or video introducing yourself so we can assess spoken English clearly, along with your resume and any dispatch/scheduling experience.

title: eCommerce CX & Operations Manager
description:

About the role



We're a growing Shopify DTC brand. We're hiring one person to build our customer experience function, keep our Shopify catalog accurate and current, and manage our day-to-day relationship with our 3PL.



This is a builder role. The helpdesk exists (Gorgias, including an AI agent) but the function — the team, the playbook, the standards — is yours to create. We use AI daily (Claude is part of our stack) and expect you to use it the same way: drafting, documenting, and automating repetitive work.



What you'll own



The CX function

> Build it: hire, train, and manage a small remote support team as we grow — starting hands-on in the queue yourself

Run Gorgias as a system: macros, rules, tagging, SLAs, AI agent configuration, and reporting

> Set the standard: brand voice in every reply, documented SOPs for every scenario, escalation paths that don't route through the founder

> TikTok Shop CX: platform SLAs, disputes, seller-score protection



The Shopify catalog — you are the source of truth

> Upload and edit products: titles, descriptions, images, variants, pricing, tags, collections

> Keep the catalog accurate: if it's wrong on the site, it's yours to catch and fix

> Execute launches and updates handed to you by the founder/marketing — quickly, completely, and without errors





The 3PL relationship

> Day-to-day liaison with our 3PL via ShipHero: order holds, address changes, returns, and shipment issues chased to resolution

> Investigate inventory discrepancies between Shopify and the warehouse and get the counts corrected

> Flag fulfillment problems (delays, packaging, receiving errors) early — with what happened, what you did, and what you need





Weekly reporting — you keep leadership informed without being asked

> Deliver a weekly CX + operations report covering: tickets opened/closed and resolution times, CSAT, orders shipped and delivered, recurring product issues (defects, sizing, damage-in-transit patterns), returns, and open fulfillment problems with their status

> Numbers plus judgment: not just what happened, but what's trending, what you fixed, and what needs a decision from leadership

> Use Claude and the reporting built into Gorgias/Shopify/ShipHero to produce this efficiently — the report should take you an hour, not an afternoon





How we measure success

> CX: first-response and resolution times within SLA, CSAT, and recurring ticket types reduced through better macros, help content, and SOPs. 

> Catalog: zero-error product listings and fast turnaround on uploads and edits. 

> Fulfillment: issues resolved without founder involvement, and inventory counts we can trust. Reporting: a weekly report delivered on time, every week, that leadership can act on without asking follow-up questions.



Requirements

> Experience running customer support for a Shopify eCommerce brand, including hiring or training support staff

> Builder-level Gorgias experience: rules, automations, tagging, AI agent — not just replying to tickets

> Hands-on Shopify catalog work: you've personally created and edited products, variants, and collections

Application form ? short interview ? paid practical exercise using realistic scenarios from our actual store ? reference checks.

title: Video Editor with AI Image & Video Generation Experience — Long-Form Story Videos (Long-Term)
description:
We write original books and bring them to life as long-form story videos - narrated audiobooks paired with visuals generated and edited by you. AI is the main tool for this work, but it is not the only tool. If you think this job is stitching together AI images with a "butterfly" zoom effect and a voiceover on top, this is not the role for you.



We are doing AI storytelling the right way. The number one goal is that our videos never read as "AI slop" or inauthentic content. That is why real video editing skill matters as much as AI generation skill.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Generate the visuals for each book: AI images and AI video clips (expect 100+ generated assets per project, sometimes more).

- Edit them into a finished long-form video: transitions, filters, color/image treatment, pacing.

- Add sound effects, background music, and (later) dialogue to match the story.

- Focus your best AI video work on the first minute or so - the hook - to grab and hold the viewer. The rest leans more on strong images and clean editing.

- We provide the narration/voiceover (the audiobook), the script, and support files. You produce the video around it. We do not hand you a script and disappear - we support the work.



WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

- Slideshows of AI images with a single effect slapped on top.

- Someone who only knows one AI tool and one prompt style.

- Mass-production "AI content farm" output. That era is over.



MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE (both are critical)

- Real video editing experience - you can edit, treat footage, use transitions/filters purposefully, mix SFX and music, and make a video feel authentic and intentional.

- Strong AI image and video generation experience - you know which models are best for which job, how to write high-quality prompts, how to vary angles and composition, and how to push AI tools to their full potential. This is not beginner knowledge.

- You understand that model choice affects quality - but you also know the model is not the only thing. Skill and judgment carry the rest.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience producing long videos (2-4 hours, sometimes longer).

- Sound design / music selection sense for storytelling.

- Familiarity with keeping content authentic and avoiding AI-detection/inauthentic-content flags.



THE WORK

- Video length: 2-4 hours, sometimes more.

- Volume: one video per month to start. We plan to increase volume over time, but this is not a mass-production role - quality comes first.

- We won't expect you to deliver the final video in one day or two. It will take time (probably around two weeks to have a completed version), perfect for someone who wants to manage the gig with other gigs.

- Long-term: we want one dependable video editor to grow with us, not a one-off freelancer.

- We will provide the AI tool for the right person.



PAY

- $35 per finished video. Payment through Wise in USD.

- Long-term, ongoing role with room to grow as our publishing volume increases.

- We have other channels, for the right person we can have other videos to edit from these channels.



HIRING PROCESS

- Apply (see below).

- Selected applicants will be asked to create a short 1-minute sample - a segment from a real story - so we can see whether your actual output matches what you describe. A portfolio alone is not enough; anyone can borrow files.

- Strong performers move on to a full paid test project.

- From there, we select our long-term video editor.



HOW TO APPLY

- Tell us your experience with video editing AND with AI image/video generation.

- List the specific AI models and tools you use, and why you choose them for different jobs.

- Share any past work you can (links). We will still verify skill through the sample.



We read every application.

title: Book Editor / Reviewer for AI-Written Victorian & Regency Stories (Long-Term)
description:
We write original Victorian and Regency stories with the help of AI, and we need a sharp human editor to review each book before it moves into production. AI writes the draft. Your job is to make sure it reads like a real book written by a real author - not something a machine produced.



You do not need to be a professional book editor. We are looking for someone with a strong love of reading, excellent English, and a sharp eye - anyone who could catch the things that pull a reader out of a story.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Read each full book and review it the way a real editor would.

- Catch inconsistencies: plot holes, character mix-ups, name or timeline errors, things that contradict earlier chapters.

- Flag anything that does not make sense or breaks the logic of the story.

- Spot "AI tells" - robotic phrasing, repetitive patterns, generic wording, jargon, or anything that sounds artificial or unnatural.

- Make sure the writing feels authentic, human, and true to the tone of a Victorian/Regency story.

- Check that the English is clean, natural, and reads well.



WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

- Someone who skims and gives it a thumbs up.

- Someone who runs it through a grammar tool and calls it done.

- Surface-level proofreading with no attention to story, sense, or authenticity.



MUST-HAVE

- Excellent English - near-native reading and writing, with a strong sense of natural phrasing.

- A sharp eye for inconsistencies, continuity errors, and things that "don't add up."

- The ability to tell when text sounds AI-generated versus genuinely human.

- A real reader - you enjoy books and know what makes a story work.



NICE TO HAVE

- Interest in the Victorian and Regency era.

- A fan of Bridgerton-style stories and period romance/drama.

- Editing, proofreading, or writing experience.



THE WORK

- Genre: Victorian and Regency stories.

- This is the review step that happens before a book goes into video/audiobook production.

- Volume: roughly one book per month to start, with room to grow over time.

- Long-term: we want one dependable reviewer to grow with us, not a one-off freelancer.



PAY

- $10 per book reviewed. Paid through Wise in USD.

- Long-term, ongoing role with room to grow as our volume increases.



HIRING PROCESS

- Apply (see below).

- Selected applicants will be asked to review a short sample - part of an actual book - so we can see whether your eye matches what you describe.

- Strong reviewers move on to a full paid test.

- From there, we select our long-term editor.



HOW TO APPLY

- Tell us about your reading and any editing/writing experience.

- Describe your English level and how you learned it.

- Tell us your favorite books or genres - and whether you enjoy the Victorian/Regency era.

- Tell us your availability and whether you can commit long-term.



We read every application. Generic copy-paste replies will not be considered.

title: Head of Paid Search & YouTube -  $5,000 USD/Month + Performance Bonus + Benefits
description:
How to Apply? Kindly fill out the application form:



About Us

We are the Golden Horde, an e-commerce company in the pain relief space. We did $10M+ in 2025 and we're on track to hit $25M in 2026. We're scaling hard this year — and Google + YouTube is the channel we're betting our trajectory on.

The Role



We need someone to own Google and YouTube end-to-end. Right now, no one does. The account spends ~$90K/month, and every week it sits without a driver is a week we're not scaling.

This is the seat where the channel lives or dies. You set the strategy, run the buying, brief the creative team on what's working, and report directly to the CEO. 



We don't have a spend cap. We have a profit floor. If you can find another $50K/month at target ROAS, we will fund it. Your job is to scale spend as aggressively as profit allows — without breaking ROAS.



What You'll Do



Campaign Management & Scaling

Launch and manage Google Search, PMax, Shopping, and YouTube campaigns 

Own the ~$90K/month current spend and build the plan to scale it past $200K/month profitably

Build audience structures, bidding strategies, and YouTube creative testing frameworks

Navigate Google's health & wellness ad policies — handle disapprovals, compliance rewrites, and landing page fixes without losing days to back-and-forth



Creative Feedback Loop (YouTube)

Brief the creative team on what's winning — angles, hooks, CTAs, pacing

When ads get disapproved, diagnose why and tell the creative team exactly what to change: script, visual, or claim language

Close the loop fast: disapproval to fixed version live in 48 hours



Analysis & Optimization

Pull daily performance data from Google Ads, GA4, and attribution tools (Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar)

Identify winners, kill losers fast

Written weekly review: ROAS, CPA, CTR, spend pacing, and the decisions behind them



Communication & Ownership

Daily Slack EOD: what you built today, what changed in the accounts, what the data is telling you, and your call on what's next

Weekly 1:1 with the CEO — come with recommendations, not asks

Flag account issues (disapprovals, policy flags, billing problems) within 1 hour of discovery

Bring a scale thesis on day 1, refine it by day 7. We don't need an auditor. We need an operator.



What We're Looking For

Proof of work first. You've personally managed Google Ads accounts at $100K+/month for at least 12 months. In the technical interview, you'll walk us through a live account you've actually scaled — campaign structure, change history, ROAS trend, the decisions you made.

Scale, not maintenance. You've taken an account from X to 2X or 3X in spend while holding ROAS. If you've only ever maintained what someone else built, this isn't the role.

YouTube ads — non-negotiable. You've built and scaled YouTube campaigns, not just Search and PMax. Show us the accounts.

Creative direction confidence. You can brief a video team on what to change about a hook, a script, or a claim — not just "make a new ad."

DTC e-commerce experience. Health, wellness, fitness, recovery, or pain relief background preferred. You know how Google evaluates health-vertical landing pages.

Fluent across the Google stack: Google Ads Manager, GA4, Google Merchant Center, Google Tag Manager, YouTube Studio.

Attribution literacy. You've used Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar — and you can explain why last-click is a lie.

You overcommunicate. You send updates before being asked. If something breaks, the team hears about it from you first — not from the dashboard.

Strong written and spoken English. You'll be on camera with the CEO weekly.

Stable internet and backup power. Non-negotiable for managing $90K+/month in live spend.



Nice-to-Have: Microsoft Ads (Bing)

If you know Microsoft Ads, you'll mirror our Google campaigns onto Bing with a budget we'll agree on

Not required to apply, but a bonus if you can show Bing accounts you've built



Compensation & Benefits

$5,000 USD/month base salary

Performance bonus tied to ROAS and spend-scale milestones — activates after successful 3-month probation

Flexible hours (weekly CEO overlap required)

Paid holidays

Paid VL and SL



Closing

If you can look at a $90K Google + YouTube account in the pain relief space and already see where the next $100K of profitable spend is hiding, we want to talk.

title: E-commerce/DTC Video Editor - For Ads (Full Time)
description:
Performance-focused · AI-augmented · Long-term



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets — and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land — who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics





Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Compensation: 900–1,100 USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3–4 finished edits per day





What you'll own





Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok — fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent — every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll — you know the first 1–2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook ? Problem ? Mechanism ? CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools — realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences





Non-negotiables



Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal — not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption — without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training — but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have





VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure — formats, ratios, placements





Who fits here





You think like a marketer, not just a creative — you care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard — you take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer — you communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal — we'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same





What we offer



This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:





Access to a premium AI tool stack — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more, all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks — you'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path — clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty — we're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us





How to apply



Read this part carefully — applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed.





Portfolio. Link 3–5 ad edits you're proud of. DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred. If something ran and performed, tell us the result.

Your workflow. Walk us through how you go from brief to final cut. What do you ask for? What do you need? How do you handle unclear direction?

Your AI work. Include at least one example where you generated or integrated AI video. Higgsfield examples are a bonus.

Logistics. Your availability and timezone.





The trial task



This role comes with a paid-style trial task — and it's where you really win it. If you're hungry for this, don't wait to be asked: complete it, edit the result, and send it in with your application.



Trial task: 
/p/drippl/Video-Editor-Trial-Task-341f520455d9802bab7ae1594d83abe4?source=copy_link



If the edit is strong, we'll hire you on the spot. This is your chance to show us — not tell us — that you're the editor we're describing.

description:
Media Buyer / Creative Strategist (Part-Time, 10-12 hrs/week)



We're a fast-growing B2B e-commerce brand selling premium pilates supplies to studio owners in the Netherlands, Belgium, the UK, Germany, and the USA. We went from €1,500/month to €113,000/month in under a year, and currently run around €10K/month in Meta Ads spend across these markets.



This is B2B lead generation media buying, not D2C. We're not optimizing for checkout conversions, we're optimizing for qualified leads from studio owners.



We're looking for someone who already runs Meta Ads lead gen campaigns and reads data like a second language: hook rate, CTR, CPL by creative, budget pacing, audience testing. You and our designer are direct partners: together you'll figure out what's working, what to scale, and where to iterate. You bring the data, they bring the creative, and the decisions come out of that back and forth.



If you can also design a static yourself, that's a welcome bonus, not a requirement.



What You'll Do:

- Manage and optimize Meta Ads campaigns across multiple markets (NL, BE, UK, DE, USA).

- Read performance data (hook rate, CTR, CPL, CPM, frequency, ROAS) and turn it into decisions: scale, pause, duplicate, retest.

- Partner closely with our designer: together you figure out what's working, what to scale, and what to iterate on. You bring the data, they bring the creative instinct.

- Manage budget pacing and audience testing inside Ads Manager.

- Report weekly on what changed, what you tested, and what's next.



What We're Looking For



Must-haves:



- Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads lead gen campaigns with a real budget, not just a course certificate.

- You can read a results table and tell us what it means, not just what it says.

- You understand creative strategy: you can talk through a hook, an audience, and an awareness level with a designer as a peer, not just hand off a brief.

- Comfortable with direct feedback, both giving and receiving.

- Working-level English, written and spoken.



Strong pluses:



- You can design a static creative yourself.

- Experience with Advantage+ Sales Campaigns / CBO structures.

- Experience running campaigns for European B2B or DTC audiences.



Who You'll Work With

- Jesse, our founder. Hands-on, fast-moving, built this from zero.

- Quincy, our marketing advisor. Direct communicator on data optimization and awareness-stage thinking.

title: Meta Junior Media Buyer
description:
WHO WE ARE



Brida is a fast-growing DTC eCommerce brand that scaled to 7 figures per month in under 2 months. We are now building our performance marketing team and looking for people who want to grow with us and help shape the next phase of this company.



We move fast, we think big, and we reward performance. If you want to manage significant ad spend, drive real revenue through data-driven decisions, and grow into a senior paid media role, this is your seat.



________________________________________________________________



THE PURPOSE OF THIS ROLE



The purpose of the Junior Media Buyer at Brida is to be rock-solid in managing the day-to-day of our Meta ad account, launching ads and making data-based decisions that drive revenue for our eCommerce brand.



As a Junior Media Buyer, you take pride in doing all the little things correctly and have the track record to prove it. Managing tens of thousands of dollars per day of someone else's capital means you pay immense attention to detail with every action you take.



You are on the front lines of all things data. You take initiative in analyzing, interpreting, and reporting performance so the whole team can make better decisions, faster. Your role is to work alongside our founders and creative team, follow our media buying systems, and ensure we are hitting KPIs month over month.



________________________________________________________________



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Onboarding



• Audit the ad account to identify top-performing ads, audiences, and creative patterns

• Learn and fully embrace Brida's media buying structure, frameworks, and KPIs



Ongoing Responsibilities



• Launch new ads and creative tests inside Meta Ads Manager following our exact structure and process

• Monitor the account daily and flag any anomalies in spend, delivery, or performance

• Communicate with the team daily on account status, launches, and any issues

• Attend weekly team calls and report on what has been launched and what is live

• Complete weekly and monthly performance reports with clear takeaways and recommended next steps

• Scale budgets and take on full creative testing ownership as you grow into the role

• Progress toward full independent ownership of the Meta ad account based on performance and reliability



________________________________________________________________



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required Experience



• Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience setting up, launching, and managing Meta ads for a Shopify or DTC eCommerce brand

• Proven experience managing ad accounts spending $5,000+ per day

• Experience setting up and troubleshooting Meta pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), and attribution tools

• Experience analyzing performance data and delivering structured reports to a team

• Familiarity with creative testing methodologies and performance creative frameworks

• Experience working in a team environment with clearly defined individual roles

• Fluent English speaker and writer



Character Traits We Hire For



• Excruciating attention to detail: nothing slips through the cracks, especially inside an ad account

• Fast mover: accessible, responsive, and acts with urgency when performance demands it

• Extremely organized: manages multiple campaigns, tests, and deadlines without dropping the ball

• Data communicator: translates numbers into clear, actionable insights the whole team can act on

• Accountable and reliable: owns the account like it's your own money on the line

• Collaborative: shares ideas, flags issues early, and keeps the team informed

• Coachable: hungry to grow your skill set and open to feedback



________________________________________________________________



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF...



• You do not pay close attention to detail: one wrong input costs real money

• You don't have proven experience running and scaling Meta ads for eCommerce

• You are a slow mover and hard to reach during core working hours

• You are not a strong communicator with both data and people

• You don't thrive in a high-operating, fast-paced environment

• You are disorganized and struggle to manage multiple priorities at once

• You are not a team player: siloed working does not exist here

• You don't understand eCommerce and what drives a customer to purchase

• You are not passionate about growth, personally and professionally



________________________________________________________________



HOURS & LOCATION



Fully Remote. Work from anywhere in the world.

Core hours:

Monday–Friday

Flexible Hours

Paid Holidays

Paid Sick Days

We care about output, not clock-watching.



________________________________________________________________



GROWTH POTENTIAL



At Brida, we highly value growth and development in all areas. With great performance, the potential for you as a Junior Media Buyer is significant:



• Grow into a Senior Media Buyer or Paid Growth Strategist owning full-funnel performance strategy

• Lead and mentor additional media buyers as the team and ad spend scales



Strong performers have no ceiling here.



________________________________________________________________



HOW TO APPLY



To make sure you have read the full post and are serious about the position, please send an application message that includes all of the following:



• Your resume

• A summary of your Meta ads experience: spend managed, platforms, and results achieved

• Your salary requirements



________________________________________________________________



Brida. Built Different. Scaling Fast.

title: Ad video creator
description:
Hi,

My name is Vera and I own multiple Scandinavian eCommerce brands. I’m

looking for a serious Performance Video Editor who understands how to create ads that

sell.

I don’t care about cinematic videos or flashy editing.

I care about one thing:

Creating video ads that generate sales.

This is an ongoing opportunity based on performance. If your work delivers results, there

will always be more work.

?

About the Role

I currently operate 2 eCommerce brands, producing

approximately 10 new Meta ad videos every week.

Your role is to create high-converting video advertisements for
 and Instagram.

You won’t be starting from scratch.

I’ll give you access to:

* My complete B-roll library.

* Product videos.

* UGC content.

* Previous winning advertisements.

* Brand assets.

* Creative materials.

* Everything I’ve collected over time.

I’ll also personally train you and show you exactly how I create my ads, why they work,

what has failed, and how I think when producing new creatives.

I’ve already built a system that works.

Each product follows proven creative concepts and multiple hooks.

Your job is to understand the system, improve it, and eventually create ads that perform

even better than mine.

That’s the goal.

?

What I’m Looking For

I’m not looking for someone who simply edits videos.

I’m looking for someone who understands performance marketing.

Someone who thinks creatively.

Someone who enjoys testing new ideas.

Someone who wants to improve every single week.

I want someone who takes ownership of the creative process instead of waiting for

instructions.

?

Skills Required

You should already know how to:

* Create high-converting Meta ads.

* Build strong hooks within the first 3 seconds.

* Create clean, professional subtitles.

* Use motion graphics and motion control naturally.

* Find additional B-roll or stock footage when needed.

* Keep viewers engaged with fast-paced editing.

* Match music and sound effects correctly.

* Create ads for both Norway and Denmark and Sweden.

?

AI Experience

AI is becoming a huge part of content creation.

Experience with tools like ChatGPT, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Google Veo/Gemini, AI

voice cloning, AI subtitles or similar tools is a big advantage.

If AI helps you work faster and create better ads, that’s exactly what I’m looking for.

?

Serious Applicants Only

I’m only interested in serious people.

If you apply, you must provide proof that you know what you’re doing.

Please include:

* Your best Meta/Facebook ad examples.

* Previous eCommerce work (if applicable).

* Portfolio.

* Results, case studies or creatives you’ve worked on.

Applications without previous work or proof of experience will not be considered.

?

Interview Process

Before we begin working together, we’ll have a short video meeting.

I want to get to know you, understand your experience, and make sure we’re a good fit

for each other.

Communication and reliability are very important to me.

?

Payment

Starting pay is $3–4 USD per hour, depending on your experience.

If you consistently create great-performing ads, there will be more work, more

responsibility and higher pay over time.

?

How to Apply

Please answer the following questions:

1. Tell me about yourself.

2. How long have you been editing videos?

3. Have you worked with eCommerce brands before?

4. Which editing software do you use?

5. Which AI tools do you use regularly?

6. Please send your best Meta/Facebook ads.

7. If I gave you one product video, how would you turn it into three completely different

ads?

8. How many hours are you available each week?

9. What computer do you use?

10. What is your internet speed?

11. Why should I hire you instead of someone else?

Finally…

At the very top of your application, write the word “Vera123” so I know you’ve read

this entire job post. 

I look forward to seeing your application.

title: Meta Ad Launcher
description:
WHO WE ARE



Brida is a fast-growing DTC eCommerce brand that scaled to 7 figures per month in under 2 months. We are now expanding our performance team and looking for detail-obsessed operators who want to be part of something that is moving fast and scaling even faster.



We run a lean, high-output team where every role matters. If you take pride in flawless execution, love living inside Meta Ads Manager, and want a stable long-term role with a brand that rewards reliability, this seat is for you.



________________________________________________________________



THE PURPOSE OF THIS ROLE



The purpose of the Ad Launcher at Brida is to be the reliable engine that gets our creatives into the ad account correctly, on time, and ready to perform. This is a pure execution role. You do not set strategy, manage budgets, or make scaling decisions. That work belongs to our Media Buyer.



Your job is to take approved creatives and copy from our team, build out campaigns, ad sets, and ads inside Meta Ads Manager following our exact naming conventions and structures, and stage everything perfectly before it goes live. When a new batch of creatives drops, nothing sits. You get it loaded.



At Brida, one mistake inside the ad account costs real money. This means you triple-check every upload before it goes out. You flag issues before anyone else notices them. You are the last line of defense between a brief and a live ad, and you treat that responsibility seriously.



________________________________________________________________



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Onboarding



• Deeply study Brida's campaign structure, naming conventions, and ad build standards

• Learn our creative delivery workflow from Drive to Ads Manager and understand every checkpoint

• Shadow the Media Buyer to fully understand how launched ads connect to our broader performance strategy



Ongoing Responsibilities



• Pull approved creatives and copy from our shared Drive and build out campaigns, ad sets, and ads in Meta Ads Manager according to our exact structure

• Upload all assets, verify destination URLs, copy, UTM parameters, and tracking before staging ads for review

• Keep all campaigns toggled off and properly staged until the Media Buyer gives the signal to go live

• Maintain strict naming conventions across every campaign so performance data reads cleanly

• Flag any issues immediately: missing files, broken links, mismatched copy, or anything that does not match the brief

• Maintain and update the creative tracker to ensure every asset is logged and accounted for

• Communicate daily with the Media Buyer and creative team on launch status and any blockers

• Perform quality checks on every ad build using our pre-launch checklist before marking tasks as complete

• Support the team with ad account organization, archiving, and keeping the account structure clean



________________________________________________________________



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required Experience



• Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience building and uploading ads inside Meta Ads Manager for a DTC or eCommerce brand

• Experience working with campaign structures, ad sets, naming conventions, and UTM tracking parameters

• Familiarity with Meta ad formats including single image, video, carousel, and collection ads

• Experience using shared file systems such as Google Drive or Dropbox to receive and manage creative assets

• Exposure to creative trackers or task management tools such as ClickUp, Notion, or Google Sheets

• Experience working within a team environment where accuracy and speed both matter

• Fluent English speaker and writer



Character Traits We Hire For



• Obsessive attention to detail: you triple-check everything before hitting publish and errors on your watch are rare

• Fast executor: when a creative batch drops, you move immediately without needing to be chased

• Proactive communicator: you flag problems before they become someone else's emergency

• Systems-oriented: you follow processes exactly and maintain clean, consistent structure without shortcuts

• Reliable and consistent: you show up, you deliver, and the team never has to wonder where things stand

• Humble and coachable: you take feedback well and are committed to doing the job the right way, not your way

• Organized under pressure: you can manage multiple ad builds and deadlines simultaneously without dropping the ball



________________________________________________________________



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF...



• You are not deeply familiar with Meta Ads Manager and how campaigns are structured

• You cut corners or skip steps when things get busy

• You need constant follow-up to complete tasks or meet deadlines

• You are looking for a strategy or decision-making role: this is a pure execution seat

• You are slow to respond or hard to reach during core working hours

• You do not communicate proactively when something is wrong or missing

• You are disorganized and struggle to manage multiple builds at once

• You have never supported a DTC or eCommerce brand inside an ad account

• You are not passionate about doing the foundational work that makes the whole system run



________________________________________________________________



HOURS & LOCATION



Fully Remote. Work from anywhere in the world.

Core hours:

Monday–Friday

Flexible Hours

Paid Holidays

Paid Sick Days

We care about output, not clock-watching.



________________________________________________________________



GROWTH POTENTIAL



At Brida, we highly value growth and development in all areas. With great performance, the potential for you as an Ad Launcher is significant:



• Grow into a Media Buyer role with ownership over campaign performance and budget decisions

• Take on broader ad operations responsibilities as the team and account scale

• Become the go-to ad operations lead as Brida expands to additional ad platforms and markets



Strong performers have no ceiling here.



________________________________________________________________



HOW TO APPLY



To make sure you have read the full post and are serious about the position, please send an application message that includes all of the following:



• Your resume

• A short summary of your Meta Ads Manager experience including the types of brands you have worked with and the volume of ads you have built and uploaded

• Your salary requirements

title: Influencer & Partnership Development Specialist

Understand each person's audience and positioning

Write personalized outreach messages (Instagram, LinkedIn,

Instead, we evaluate:



Reply rate

Quality of replies

Meaningful conversations started

Qualified meetings

Professional communication

Continuous improvement

Research

Personalized outreach

Follow-ups

Progress tracking

Reporting

Fixed monthly payment: PHP 8,000

Additional performance incentives every month

PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES

JPY 500 for each qualified reply that demonstrates genuine interest in discussing a collaboration.

To apply, complete the following exercise.

A US-based real estate influencer

A broker serving international clients

Write a personalized outreach message.

Write ONE follow-up message.

Explain:



Why you chose this person

Why your message should receive a reply

What response you hope to achieve

4. Target Link



Provide their Instagram, LinkedIn, or website.



Applications may not be considered if:



Messages are generic

No personalization is shown

No strategy is explained

The selected target is not relevant

LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



Successful applicants will have the opportunity to continue working with us long-term.



Compensation and responsibilities will grow based on:



Performance

Reply quality

Meeting quality

Overall contribution



If you enjoy research, strategic communication, and building valuable business relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Australian Tax Accountant

About Us

Deryan Financial Group is a family-owned accounting and finance firm with over 40 years of experience helping clients make smarter financial and lending decisions.

The Opportunity

If you're an experienced tax professional who takes pride in accuracy, organisation, and compliance — this is your opportunity to take ownership of individual and sole trader tax return preparation within our growing accounting division.

You'll manage the end-to-end preparation of individual tax returns and small sole trader tax returns, ensure client files are complete and accurate before lodgement, and maintain compliance with current ATO requirements. You'll work closely with our senior accountants and tax agents, keeping returns moving efficiently through review so the team can focus on advisory and more complex work.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Location: Cebu - Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday | 7:00 AM – 5:30 PM



Job Overview

Level Up is seeking an experienced Accounting Manager to lead the company's accounting operations and ensure accurate financial reporting, regulatory compliance, and effective financial management. This role is responsible for overseeing day-to-day accounting functions, supervising the accounting team, preparing financial and management reports, supporting budgeting and cash flow activities, and providing financial insights that drive strategic business decisions.





Key Responsibilities:



Financial Management

Oversee all accounting operations, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and other core accounting functions.

Prepare, review, and analyze financial statements to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

Lead the annual budgeting process and prepare monthly Budget vs. Actual variance reports for management review.

Generate timely financial and management reports to support business planning and strategic decision-making.

Ensure the accuracy and integrity of accounting records and financial data.

Leadership & Team Management

Lead, supervise, mentor, and develop the Accounting team, including the Accounting Supervisor and other accounting staff.

Assign, monitor, and review work to ensure timely and accurate completion of accounting deliverables.

Conduct performance evaluations, provide coaching, and identify training opportunities to strengthen team performance.

Compliance & Audit

Ensure compliance with Philippine Financial Reporting Standards (PFRS), tax regulations, statutory requirements, and company policies.

Manage internal and external audit activities by coordinating with auditors, preparing supporting documents, and addressing audit findings.

Monitor updates in accounting standards, tax regulations, and industry best practices, ensuring timely implementation of necessary changes.





Treasury & Cash Flow Management

Monitor company cash flow and liquidity requirements.

Oversee the scheduling of supplier payments, expense disbursements, and other financial obligations.

Prepare weekly disbursement schedules and coordinate funding requirements with the Finance Department.

Process Improvement & Internal Controls

Identify opportunities to improve accounting systems, processes, and workflows.

Develop, implement, and maintain strong internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure financial accuracy.

Recommend process improvements that enhance operational efficiency and reporting effectiveness.

Business Partnership

Collaborate with senior management by providing financial analysis and recommendations to support strategic initiatives.

Coordinate closely with the Finance Manager on budgeting, cash flow requirements, and payment schedules.

Liaise with auditors, tax consultants, regulatory agencies, banks, and other external stakeholders as needed.

Financial & Management Reports

The Accounting Manager will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, and ensuring the timely submission of the following reports:

Income Statement

Balance Sheet (Statement of Financial Position)

Statement of Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)

Statement of Operating Expenses

Cash Flow Statement (in coordination with the Finance Manager)

Schedule of Property, Plant and Equipment (PPE)

Cash in Bank Schedule

Bank Reconciliation Statements

Sales Report

Sales Returns and Allowances Report

Budget vs. Actual (Variance) Reports

Notes and Disclosures to the Financial Statements

Other financial, accounting, and management reports as required by Management

Other Responsibilities

Perform other duties and responsibilities that may be assigned by Management from time to time.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, Accounting Technology, Finance, or a related field.

Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation is highly preferred.

At least 6-8 years of managerial experience in Accounting or Finance, preferably within the real estate industry. Candidates from other asset-intensive industries are also encouraged to apply.

Strong knowledge of financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, cash flow management, audit coordination, and internal controls.

Proven experience preparing financial statements, management reports, and supporting schedules.

Thorough understanding of Philippine Financial Reporting Standards (PFRS), tax laws, and other regulatory requirements.

Experience managing internal and external audits and coordinating with government agencies.

Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. Experience with ERP systems and SAP is an advantage.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.

Proven leadership experience with the ability to build, coach, and develop high-performing teams.

Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across all levels of the organization.

title: AI Video Ad Editor (AI Image + Video Generation)
description:
We make short AI-generated video ads for ecommerce and need an editor who's genuinely good at it.



We give you a script, reference visuals, and a demo product. You turn it into a polished ad that matches the intended style — and add your own visual ideas where it makes sense. You'll generate both AI images and AI video, fix weak outputs, and edit everything into a strong final piece.



The ads are often in another language (Japanese). You do NOT need to speak it — we provide translated scripts, timing, and emotional direction so you can nail the visuals.



WHAT YOU'LL DO DAILY:

- Reverse-engineer a reference video (pacing, shots, camera, emotional beats) and recreate the format — capture WHY it works, don't just copy it

- Generate consistent, defect-free AI images and convincing AI video

- Work from rough or incomplete briefs and fill in the visual details yourself

- Edit, add captions/audio/timing, and deliver one finished ad per day



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU:

- Spot AI defects instantly and never accept the first usable-looking generation

- Move fast without endlessly over-perfecting

- Apply feedback without repeating the same mistakes

- Take ownership of the final video quality



YOU'RE NOT A FIT IF YOU:

- Need every shot explained in detail

- Only know how to copy prompts

- Produce static, generic, obviously-AI scenes

- Need several days for a single short video



THE PAID TEST:

One demo video. We give you a reference ad, a demo product, and a full script. You deliver one polished AI ad. We pay $60 for this demo. If it's strong and fast, we move into ongoing daily work.



TO APPLY, SEND:

1. 2–3 of your best AI video samples (links)

2. The AI tools you use (image gen, video gen, editor)

3. Your usual turnaround time for one short ad

4. Answer this so we know you read the post: what's the first thing you check in a reference video before recreating it?

description:
Marketplace Performance Manager



About Us: Picster is one of the world's fastest-growing travel photography companies, operating in almost 100 destinations across Europe, Asia, the Middle East and beyond. Every day we help travellers capture proposals, honeymoons, family holidays and other unforgettable 
nts. As we continue to grow, we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys improving things. Someone who's naturally curious, loves understanding customers and gets satisfaction from making good products even better.



About the Role: 



This isn't a customer support role. It's a performance role.



Your job is to make sure our experiences perform as well as they possibly can across every marketplace.



You'll be responsible for increasing reviews, understanding customer behaviour, identifying opportunities for improvement and helping every new city launch get off to the strongest possible start.



You'll spend your time looking at what's working, what isn't, speaking to customers, analysing feedback and working with the rest of the team to make improvements.



If you enjoy spotting patterns, solving problems and making a measurable difference, you'll love this role.



What You'll Be Doing: 



Grow our reviews - Reviews are one of the biggest drivers of our business.

You'll own our review acquisition strategy across Airbnb, GetYourGuide, Viator and other platforms.



That means:



Finding new ways to encourage customers to leave reviews



Testing different follow-up strategies



Tracking what's working and what isn't



Looking at review performance across different cities



Sharing ideas that help us continuously improve



This isn't about sending more reminders.



It's about understanding why customers choose to leave reviews and creating experiences that naturally encourage them to do so.



Help new cities succeed:  Whenever we launch a new city or experience, you'll be involved from day one.



You'll work with our Expansion and Operations teams to make sure everything is ready before the first customer arrives.

After launch, you'll monitor how things are going, speak to customers, collect feedback and work with the team to make improvements quickly. We want every new city to improve week after week, and you'll play a big part in making that happen.



Become the voice of our customers



You'll spend a lot of time listening.



Reading reviews.



Talking to customers.



Looking for trends.



Trying to understand why people loved an experience - or why they didn't.



When you notice something, we don't want it sitting in a spreadsheet, we want you to work with the relevant team to fix it. Work across the business.. You'll regularly work with:



Operations

Expansion

Photographer Management

Customer Success

Post Production

Management



Your role is to connect customer feedback with action.



Sometimes that might be improving a meeting point.



Sometimes it might be changing a photographer briefing.



Sometimes it might be identifying a process that's causing unnecessary frustration.



What Success Looks Like: 



This role has clear goals, some of the KPIs include:



- Increase marketplace reviews from XX to YY by DATE

- Achieve agreed review acquisition targets across every platform

- Improve review conversion rates month after month

- Ensure every new city launch starts strongly and continues to improve

- Identify trends before they become problems

- Deliver practical recommendations that improve customer satisfaction

- We're not interested in reports that simply explain what went wrong.

- We're looking for someone who enjoys finding solutions.



What We're Looking For: 



We're much more interested in mindset than experience.

You'll probably enjoy this role if you:

Naturally ask questions

Like solving problems

Notice details that other people miss

Enjoy speaking to customers

Are organised and proactive

Like turning data into action

Are comfortable making decisions

Write excellent English

Use AI tools to work more efficiently

Take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do

Experience in customer experience, hospitality or marketplace management is helpful, but it's not essential.



Why Join Picster?



- You'll have genuine ownership from day one.

- If you have a good idea, we'll encourage you to test it.

- If you find a better way of doing something, we'll implement it.

- We're a growing business, which means you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact rather than simply following processes that someone else created.

- If you enjoy improving businesses, making customers happier and seeing the results of your work, we'd love to hear from you.

title: High-Level Executive Partner / Executive Assistant with at least 3 years of Experience

Organizing and managing executive inboxes, drafting
s, and following up on important communications

title: Creative Strategist (Performance Ads) – E-commerce/Dropshipping
description:
About Us



We’re a fast-growing e-commerce group operating multiple dropshipping and branded e-commerce funnels.

We scale aggressively through paid ads, high-volume creative testing, and data-driven decision making.



Our team consists of media buyers, funnel builders, video editors, and customer support.

We are now hiring a Creative Strategist to own and systemize everything related to ad creatives.



The Role

As a Creative Strategist, you own the strategy behind all paid ad creatives.

You do not edit videos or launch ads.



Your job is to d
:

- Do creative research.

- What creatives get made.

- Which angles get tested.

- Why something wins or loses.

- How winners are iterated and scaled.



You will work closely with the CEO, media buyers, and video editors to lower CPA and unlock scale.

- What You’ll Do

- Develop creative angles and concepts for Meta ads across multiple funnels.

- Translate ad performance data into actionable creative insights.

- Write clear, detailed creative briefs for video editors.

- Define weekly creative testing priorities and roadmaps.

- Analyze hooks, retention, watch time, scroll stop, and fatigue.

- D
 when to iterate, kill, or scale creatives.

- Ensure strong alignment between ads, landing pages, and funnels.

- Collaborate with media buyers to improve CPA, stability, and scalability.

- Maintain structured creative documentation and testing learnings.



What You Bring

- Minimum IQ of 120

- Fluent in English (written and spoken)

- 2+ years experience with performance creatives for E-commerce Meta ads.

- Strong direct response mindset. You care about results, not just aesthetics.

- Deep understanding of hooks, angles, retention, and creative testing.

- Ability to read ad data and turn it into clear creative direction.

- Experience briefing and managing video editors or creators.

- High attention to detail and structured way of thinking.

- Ownership mentality. You spot problems early and act without hand-holding.

- Comfortable working with Google Sheets and performance reports.

Note on assessments. Short skills or aptitude tasks may be part of our selection process.



How We Work (and What You’ll Get)

- Part-time with flexible hours. Clear path to full-time for top performers.

- Compensation: $5–$8/hour depending on experience + performance bonuses.

- Approved expense reimbursement if applicable.

- Merit-based raises as your impact grows.

- Direct collaboration with the CEO and media buyers.

- Access to proven funnels, ad accounts, SOPs, and real ad spend.

- Long-term growth opportunities into Head of Creative or broader strategy roles.



How to Apply

- Put your favorite movie or series in the subject line or title. This helps us spot detail-oriented applicants.



Please include:

- Your CV or Resume.

- Examples of ad creatives or brands you worked on. Screenshots or Looms are fine.

- A short paragraph explaining how you approach creative testing and iteration.

- Your availability. Hours per week.

- Your IQ in your account. You can do this for free on OnlineJobs.



No AI-generated applications. We read carefully and can tell.

title: AI Digital Marketer
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a results-driven AI Digital Marketer to plan, create, launch and optimise high-performing marketing campaigns for our agency clients.



This is not a traditional marketing role. You will be expected to use artificial intelligence, automation tools and performance data to produce campaigns faster, improve creative output and generate measurable business results.



You will work with clients from different industries, understand their business goals and turn them into effective campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube,
 and WhatsApp.



The ideal candidate is creative, analytical, commercially minded and comfortable experimenting with new AI tools.



Key Responsibilities

AI-Powered Campaign Creation

Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns for multiple agency clients.

Use AI tools to research markets, analyse competitors and identify customer pain points.

Generate campaign concepts, advertising angles, hooks, scripts and promotional offers.

Create AI-assisted ad copy, social media content, landing-page copy and
 campaigns.

Develop creative briefs for static advertisements, videos, reels and short-form content.

Use AI image and video tools to improve the speed and quality of content production.

Personalise campaigns for different customer segments, industries and platforms.

Performance Marketing

Manage and optimise paid campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads and other relevant platforms.

Conduct audience research, keyword research and competitor analysis.

Set up campaign structures, targeting, budgets and conversion tracking.

Monitor cost per lead, click-through rate, conversion rate, return on advertising spend and other key metrics.

Conduct A/B testing on creatives, copy, offers, audiences and landing pages.

Identify underperforming campaigns and make improvements quickly.

Prepare regular campaign performance reports with clear recommendations.



Marketing Automation

Build automated lead-generation and follow-up workflows.

Use AI and automation tools to improve lead nurturing, customer engagement and campaign reporting.

Develop automated
, WhatsApp and customer relationship management journeys.

Identify repetitive marketing processes that can be automated.

Maintain proper documentation for campaign systems, prompts and workflows.



Client Management

Understand each client’s business model, target audience, products and revenue goals.

Translate client objectives into practical marketing strategies.

Present campaign ideas, results and recommendations clearly.

Manage multiple client accounts and campaign deadlines.

Communicate proactively with clients and internal tea
mbers.

Ensure all deliverables meet the agency’s quality standards.



Content and Creative Strategy

Develop content calendars and campaign plans.

Write compelling advertisements, captions, landing pages,
 messages and video scripts.

Identify strong customer problems, emotional triggers and buying motivations.

Work with designers, video editors, media buyers and account managers.

Monitor market trends, viral content formats and new advertising opportunities.

Ensure that all content remains relevant to the client’s brand and business objectives.



Key Performance Indicators



Performance will be measured based on:

Number and quality of leads generated.

Cost per lead and customer acquisition cost.

Campaign conversion rate.

Return on advertising spend.

Client campaign performance and satisfaction.

Speed and quality of campaign execution.

Number of successful creative tests launched.

Improvement in campaign results over time.

Accuracy and timeliness of reporting.

Effective use of AI and automation to increase productivity.



Requirements

Diploma or degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Digital Media or a related field.

At least one year of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, content marketing or a related role.

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads is strongly preferred.

Strong understanding of digital advertising funnels, lead generation and conversion optimisation.

Good copywriting and content-creation skills.

Comfortable using artificial intelligence tools for research, copywriting, campaign development and content production.

Able to interpret campaign data and make practical decisions.

Strong project-management and time-management skills.

Able to manage multiple client accounts in a fast-paced agency environment.

Strong written and spoken English.

Knowledge of Mandarin, Malay or other languages is an advantage.

Preferred AI and Marketing Tools



Experience with some of the following tools will be advantageous:



ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini

Canva

CapCut

Midjourney or other AI image-generation tools

AI video-generation tools

Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

Google Analytics

Google Tag Manager

TikTok Ads Manager

HubSpot or other CRM platforms

Zapier or Make

 and WhatsApp automation platforms



Candidates are not required to know every tool, but they must be willing and able to learn new technologies quickly.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a strong fit for this role if you:



Enjoy testing new AI tools and marketing strategies.

Care about business results instead of vanity metrics.

Can turn a simple product or service into a compelling campaign.

Are comfortable working with different industries and client personalities.

Can balance creativity with data and commercial thinking.

Take ownership of your campaigns and solve problems independently.

Are resourceful, adaptable and committed to continuous improvement.

What We Offer

Exposure to clients from multiple industries.

Opportunities to work on real campaigns with measurable business impact.

Access to AI tools, marketing technology and training.

Career progression into roles such as Senior Digital Marketer, Performance Marketing Manager, AI Marketing Strategist or Account Director.

A fast-paced environment where good ideas can be tested quickly.

Performance incentives based on individual and campaign results.

Application Requirements



Please submit:



Your résumé.

Examples of campaigns, advertisements or content you have created.

A brief explanation of how you currently use AI in digital marketing.

Relevant campaign results, including cost per lead, conversion rate or return on advertising spend where available.

Your expected salary and earliest available starting date.

title: Tourism Promotion Specialist
description:
Oras ng Trabaho

9:00 umaga - 6:00 hapon, 1 oras na pahinga sa tanghalian, 2 araw na pahinga bawat linggo

Mga Tungkulin sa Trabaho

1.Buong pananagutan sa pakikipag-ugnayan sa mga lokal na ahensya sa paglalakbay at institusyong panturismo sa Pilipinas, gumawa ng pang-araw-araw na komunikasyon sa negosyo at negosasyon, iparating nang mahusay ang mga bentahe ng mga produktong panturismo ng Tsina ng aming kumpanya at mga patakaran sa pakikipagtulungan, at itaguyod ang malalim na pakikipagtulungan sa pagitan ng dalawang panig.

2.Panatilihin ang mga umiiral na mapagkukunan ng ahensya sa paglalakbay na nakikipagtulungan, tumugon kaagad sa mga pangangailangan sa pakikipagtulungan at lutasin ang mga problema sa negosyo, sundan ang pagpapatupad ng pakikipagtulungan, tiyakin ang maayos na pagpapatuloy ng pakikipagtulungan, at palawakin ang mga matatag na pangmatagalang channel sa pakikipagtulungan sa lokal na turismo.

3.Tumulong sa pagkolekta ng impormasyon tungkol sa lokal na merkado ng turismo sa Pilipinas, mga pangangailangan ng mga turista at mga kilos ng mga katunggali, ayusin at ibalik ang impormasyon sa koponan sa loob ng bansa upang makatulong na mapabuti ang mga produktong panturismo at mga plano sa promosyon.

4.Tumulong sa cross-border na koordinasyon ng negosyo, pag-synchronize ng impormasyon at iba pang kaugnay na pantulong na gawain upang tiyakin ang walang hadlang na komunikasyon sa negosyo sa pagitan ng Tsina at Pilipinas, at tumugon kaagad at aktibo sa lahat ng komunikasyon sa trabaho.

Mga Kinakailangan sa Trabaho

1.Katutubong nagsasalita ng Filipino, bihasa sa Ingles (pakikinig, pagsasalita, pagbabasa at pagsusulat), kayang gumawa ng walang hadlang na komunikasyon sa trabaho, pagsusulat ng teksto at pasalitang negosasyon; Ingles ang pang-araw-araw na wika sa trabaho.

2.Pamilyar sa lokal na merkado ng turismo sa Pilipinas, sa paraan ng pagpapatakbo ng mga lokal na ahensya sa paglalakbay at mga kagustuhan sa paglalakbay ng mga turista; mas gusto ang mga aplikanteng may kaugnay na karanasan sa industriya ng turismo o koordinasyon ng negosyo.

3.May mahusay na kasanayan sa komunikasyon, negosasyon sa negosyo at pagpapanatili ng kostumer, proactive at responsable, may malakas na kakayahang magpatupad, kayang magsulong ng pagpapatupad ng negosyo nang mag-isa.

4.May pangunahing kakayahan sa pagsusulat ng teksto at pag-edit ng nilalaman, kayang mabilis na gumawa ng mga materyal sa promosyon ng turismo, at bihasa sa pangunahing operasyon ng software ng opisina.

5.Maingat at mahigpit sa trabaho, may malakas na kamalayan sa cross-cultural na komunikasyon, mataas na pakiramdam ng responsibilidad at mabuting espiritu ng koponan.

Suweldo at Mga Benepisyo

Batayang Suweldo: 30,000 Peso bawat buwan

Mga Patakaran sa Komisyon sa Pagbebenta

1.Gantimpala ng 200 Peso para sa bawat ahensya sa paglalakbay na matagumpay na nakontak at nairehistro sa sistema ng kumpanya.

2.Gantimpala ng 800 Peso para sa bawat wastong order ng grupo ng paglalakbay na ibinigay ng ahensya sa paglalakbay na nakikipagtulungan, kinakalkula batay sa huling bilang ng grupo na kinumpirma ng kumpanya.

Walang komisyon sa pagbebenta sa kasalukuyang buwan kung ang kabuuang bilang ng nairehistrong ahensya sa paglalakbay ay mas mababa sa 10 sa isang buwan.

title: VA - Meta Infrastructure & Network Assistant
description:
Affiliate Network VA — Everflow Ops & Meta Ad Account Support

Type: Full-time | Remote

Hours: European



About Us

We're a performance marketing company running both an affiliate network and an in-house media buying team. We work across multiple verticals in Tier-1 markets. Small team, fast pace, no corporate bureaucracy.



What You'll Do

Network Side (Everflow):



- Set up and configure offers in Everflow — creatives, payouts, caps, geo/device targeting, tracking links

- Onboard new affiliates and get them approved on the right offers

- Respond to affiliate requests: link issues, payout questions, creative requests, offer access

- Monitor for tracking/postback issues and flag anything broken

- Keep offer status accurate (paused, capped, expired)



Media Buying Side (Meta):



- Troubleshoot ad account issues — restrictions, appeals, rejections, billing errors

- File and follow up on appeals through Meta support

- Assist with Business Manager admin: adding assets, user access, page/pixel connections

- Track ad account status across a portfolio of accounts in our spreadsheets



Requirements



- 1+ year hands-on with an affiliate tracking platform (Everflow, HasOffers/Tune, Affise, iREV, or similar)

- Working knowledge of Meta Business Manager and ad account structure

- Strong written English — you'll be the front line with affiliates daily

- Organized and proactive: you notice problems before we do

- Reliable internet, quiet work setup, available during agreed hours



Nice to Have



- Direct Everflow experience

- Experience dealing with Meta ad account restrictions/appeals

- Familiarity with Keitaro or other tracker software

- Basic understanding of postbacks, S2S tracking, and conversion flows



What We Offer



- Competitive salary based on experience (state your expected monthly rate)

- Hands-on training on our systems and processes

- Direct access to founders — no layers of management



How to Apply

Send a reply with:



1. Which tracking platform(s) you've used and what you did on them
