Applications that skip these questions won't be reviewed. Put "NETWORK VA - [your first name]" in the subject line.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — High Volume, Core Team Role (Room to Grow)
description:
We're FaberX, an
 & SMS marketing agency for e-commerce brands. We publish a high volume of short-form video — talking-head clips and screen-recorded 
 teardowns" (breaking down real brand
s and showing what we'd build instead).



This is a core team role, not a one-off gig. We're looking for someone hungry, fast, and reliable who wants to grow with us and become a central part of the team.



You'll turn out a high volume of short vertical videos — up to around 30 a day. Some are simple (the benchmark is roughly 5 minutes to cut a clean 1-minute vertical); some are more involved when you're sourcing overlays, b-roll, or assets. And if you can prove you deliver quality at scale, there's the opportunity to take on longer-form YouTube editing in the future too.



HOW PAY WORKS

Pay is monthly and reflects your output and the complexity of the work — the more you produce at our standard, the more you earn. It starts in the $400–$650/month range depending on volume and complexity, with room to grow to $750+ for top performers and higher-paid YouTube edits later on. Final rate is agreed after a short trial. Tell me the rate you'd want when you apply.



THE TRIAL

Because this is competitive pay with genuine room to grow, shortlisted editors do a short trial first — a few sample edits (around 3 types of content I need) on our style — so I can see your speed and quality before we start. Only editors who hit the standard move forward.



WHAT A TYPICAL DAY LOOKS LIKE



Turn batches of raw footage into short vertical videos (9:16)

Mostly simple, fast edits: clean cuts, captions, basic b-roll/overlays

Some heavier edits when sourcing assets, overlays, or effects

Consistent style and quality across everything you deliver

Fast, reliable turnaround — volume matters here



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Fast, clean short-form editing (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) — show it in your portfolio

Someone hungry who wants a long-term, core role and will grow with us

Speed and consistency at volume, without dropping quality

Fluent with CapCut and/or Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve

Comfortable with captions, b-roll, overlays, and simple motion/text

Reliable, communicative, dependable, and takes feedback well

Reliable internet and a machine that handles editing smoothly



NICE TO HAVE



DTC / e-commerce or marketing/agency editing experience

Long-form / YouTube editing

Basic sound design and color correction



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

To apply, do all five:



Start your application with the word REELS so I know you read the full post.

Send a link to your portfolio or 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited (say what you did on each).

In 2–3 sentences, tell me: what makes a short-form hook actually work?

Tell me roughly how many simple 1-minute videos you can realistically edit in a day.

Tell me the rate you'd want (per video or per month) and how you'd prefer to be paid.



Applications that skip any of these, or that are copy-paste generic, won't be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants do a short trial before regular work.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
We are posting this role as Customer Support Specialist, which is the more standard market title. At Edstruments, our customers are called partners, so internally you will hear this role referred to as Partner Support Specialist (or PSS). Same role, different vocabulary. We default to “partner” language throughout our team, our tools, and our documentation, and your day-to-day will use that language too.



About Edstruments



Edstruments empowers K12 and nonprofit leaders with modern financial software spanning the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle and Budget Planning & Management. Our platform helps our partners align their spending and budgets to strategic objectives so that they can best achieve their mission. As a fast-growing startup, we add several new partners each month, and our platform is currently in use by organizations across multiple states in the US. We are seeking individuals who are excited to play a critical role in helping our partners achieve their missions.



Role Overview



The Customer Support Specialist will be the first line of defense on chat and
, helping our partners resolve technical and administrative issues, ensuring smooth communication, and troubleshooting challenges. You will manage incoming chats and
s, track tickets, and ensure partner needs are met efficiently. The role also involves vendor outreach, administrative tasks, and product setup for new clients. You handle most questions yourself by checking our documentation and Slack history first, escalate with what you have already tried and found, and keep partners and teammates updated without being asked. Over time, you will have opportunities to take on more advanced roles as you grow with the company.



Key Responsibilities



* First-Contact Resolution: Independently troubleshoot and resolve partner inquiries, checking our documentation and Slack history before escalating, ensuring a 70% first-contact resolution rate for partner inquiries. [Within the first 3 months of joining].

* Response Time: Respond to partner inquiries within 5 minutes for chats and 3 hours for
s during your regular business hours. [Ongoing].

* Ticket Management: Manage support conversations in Intercom and track work on Trello cards to ensure all issues are resolved promptly. Close 90% of inquiries within 48 hours.

* Client Onboarding: Assist with the initial setup of our systems when a new client onboards to ensure successful data syncs with a 90% success rate.

* Vendor Outreach & Admin: Provide support with vendor outreach and administrative tasks, as needed. [Ongoing].

* Collaboration: Work with the Partner Success and Product teams to communicate findings from partner interactions and ensure partner needs are addressed. [Ongoing].



Key Outcomes



* Achieve a 4.5/5 satisfaction rating or higher for partner support interactions (chat/email).

* Close 90% of support tickets within 48 hours of receiving inquiries.

* Ensure 90% success rate for assigned client onboarding tasks.

* Own inquiries end to end: resolve the majority independently and close the loop with the partner, escalating only with clear context on what you’ve already tried.



Must-Have Qualifications



* 2+ years of experience in technical support, software support, or a related role.

* Strong technical aptitude and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn and troubleshoot software-related issues.

* Experience with support and ticketing tools (Intercom, HubSpot, or similar) and a proven ability to resolve customer issues in a timely manner.

* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present technical information clearly to non-technical users.

* Strong attention to detail and excellent time management skills.

* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

* Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to research answers, draft partner replies, and work faster.

* Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision: you find answers, make a judgment call, and proactively communicate status without being chased.



Preferred Qualifications



* Experience in customer support for SaaS platforms or other software solutions.

* Experience in vendor outreach or administrative tasks.

* Background in the education or nonprofit sectors is a plus.



Logistical Notes



This is a 100% remote role with a flexible start date, but availability during US Pacific Time business hours (8 am - 5 pm) is required.



Edstruments does not and will not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender orientation, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status in any of its hiring decisions or other activities.



Compensation



The salary range for this role is $1,000-$2,000/month.



Why Edstruments?



* Mission-Driven Work: Work with a team passionate about improving financial processes for K12 and nonprofit organizations.

* Growth Opportunities: We offer potential for career advancement and development as the company scales.

* Remote Flexibility: Join a 100% remote team with a flexible start date.

title: Social Media Operations & Instagram DM Setter
description:
# Instagram Outbound DM & Social Media Posting Assistant



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented assistant to manage daily social media publishing and manually start conversations with warm followers through Instagram.



This is an execution-focused role.



Your primary responsibility is to message people who have already engaged with our content and generate the first reply. Once someone replies, our sales team takes over the conversation.



You will not be responsible for qualifying leads, explaining our services, pitching, closing sales, or managing inbound conversations.



## About RicFit



RicFit helps overlooked and non-academy footballers improve their performance, build their careers, and create opportunities to reach the professional level.



Our audience consists primarily of ambitious footballers aged 19–29 across the United States, Canada, and Europe.



We publish daily football content and generate consistent engagement from followers, post likers, commenters, story viewers, story reactors, and poll respondents.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Instagram Outbound DMs



* Manually message warm followers and content engagers

* Reach out to new followers, story reactors, poll respondents, commenters, and post likers

* Check each conversation before sending a message

* Select the correct message based on the person’s engagement

* Personalize every message using the person’s name and relevant context

* Send messages naturally rather than using rapid or robotic copy-pasting

* Follow up with people who have not replied

* Complete a maximum of three outreach touches per person

* Stop messaging immediately once the person replies

* Apply and remove Instagram labels to track outreach status

* Flag any conversations that are not transferred correctly to the setter team



The objective is simple:



**Start a genuine conversation and generate the first reply.**



You will not:



* Qualify prospects

* Pitch RicFit programs

* Discuss pricing

* Send payment links

* Book or close sales

* Continue conversations after someone replies

* Manage general inbound DMs



### Social Media Publishing



* Upload and schedule Instagram Reels, carousels, posts, and stories

* Format captions, covers, tags, thumbnails, and links correctly

* Follow the content calendar and publishing schedule

* Check every post before and after publishing

* Confirm that captions, formatting, audio, covers, and dimensions are correct

* Organize content files and track what has been published

* Repurpose approved content across TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn when assigned



## Daily Workflow



1. Complete all scheduled follow-ups from previous days

2. Remove outreach labels from anyone who has replied

3. Start new conversations with warm Instagram engagers

4. Work through lead sources in the assigned priority order

5. Post and check scheduled social media content

6. Submit the daily performance report



## Daily Reporting



You will report:



* New people contacted

* Follow-up messages completed

* Total messages sent

* Replies generated

* Reply rate

* Conversations transferred to the setter team

* Content published

* Any posting errors

* Any Instagram warnings or account restrictions



## Working Hours



* Part-time

* 25–30 hours per week

* Approximately 5–6 hours per day

* Monday to Friday

* Consistent daily availability is required

* Some flexibility may be required for scheduled weekend content



The exact outreach target will be established during the paid trial based on speed, accuracy, reply quality, and Instagram account safety.



## Requirements



* Previous experience with Instagram outreach, appointment setting, lead generation, or community engagement

* Previous experience publishing content for a business or personal brand

* Strong written English

* Excellent attention to detail

* Comfortable completing repetitive manual tasks accurately

* Able to make messages sound natural and personal

* Comfortable following scripts, SOPs, and strict workflows

* Reliable smartphone and internet connection

* Comfortable working inside the native Instagram mobile application

* Experience with Google Sheets and Google Drive

* Experience with Canva, CapCut, Meta Business Suite, or social scheduling platforms is preferred

* Able to handle confidential account access professionally



## Account Safety Requirements



* No third-party Instagram outreach tools

* No browser extensions

* No automated outbound messaging

* No rapid-fire messaging

* No identical messages sent repeatedly without personalization

* Stop outreach immediately if Instagram displays an activity warning

* Follow all account-security and access procedures



Protecting the Instagram account is more important than hitting an outreach target.



## What We Are Looking For



* Reliable

* Consistent

* Highly organized

* Fast learner

* Strong attention to detail

* Comfortable with high-volume execution

* Able to follow instructions without improvising unnecessarily

* Able to work independently

* Able to maintain accurate daily records

* Available for a long-term position



## Performance Metrics



Performance will be measured by:



* Outreach completed

* Follow-ups completed on time

* Reply rate

* Number of conversations transferred

* Message quality

* Personalization accuracy

* Posting accuracy

* Reporting accuracy

* Reliability

* Account safety



## Paid Trial



Final candidates will complete a short paid trial.



The trial may include:



* Writing ten personalized Instagram opening messages

* Messaging a controlled list of warm leads

* Completing follow-ups correctly

* Applying and removing Instagram labels

* Uploading and formatting one carousel

* Uploading and formatting one Reel

* Recording results in a tracking sheet

* Recording a short Loom explaining the completed work



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. A short introduction

2. Your Instagram outreach or appointment-setting experience

3. Your social media publishing experience

4. Examples of accounts or brands you have worked with

5. The tools you have experience using

6. Your current availability

7. Your expected monthly rate

8. A short Loom video introducing yourself



Start your application with:



**“I understand my goal is to generate the first reply.”**



Applications without this sentence will not be reviewed.

title: HR Specialist/ (Full-Time, Remote – Philippines)
description:
Company Overview

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. This role emphasizes employee relations management, requiring candidates to be adaptable and detail-oriented in a fast-paced working environment. Fluent in Chinese is a strong plus.



Job Summary

The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. The ideal candidate must be independent, empathetic, proficient in employee communication, and familiar with employee risk management. You need to be process-driven, meticulous, and capable of adapting to a fast-paced remote working environment. Candidates with Chinese language proficiency will be given priority consideration.



Key Responsibilities

1. Full-cycle Recruitment: Publish job openings, screen resumes, conduct interviews, coordinate hiring processes, and complete talent matching according to department staffing demands.

2. Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage employee onboarding, job transfer, status adjustment, resignation and termination procedures; organize and file employee documents to ensure complete and standardized personnel files.

3. Performance Management: Assist in optimizing performance appraisal systems, organize regular performance evaluations, sort assessment data, follow up on performance feedback, and complete data statistics.

4. Employee Relations: Maintain daily communication with employees, respond to HR-related inquiries, properly handle daily employee relation issues, and build a positive team atmosphere.

5. Training & Employee Care: Organize employee onboarding training and deliver HR policy training; arrange one-on-one employee interviews and emotional counseling, track staff dynamics, and improve employee retention rate.



Qualifications & Requirements

1. Minimum 2 years of solid HR working experience, familiar with recruitment, employee lifecycle management, and performance management processes.

2. Proficient in employee relations management, skilled in one-on-one counseling, emotional guidance, staff care and training.

3. Strong data sorting ability, rigorous and detail-oriented in daily work.

4. Excellent interpersonal and coordination skills to communicate with all-level employees.

5. Self-motivated and responsible, capable of independently handling full-cycle HR tasks.

6. Proficient in Office software, able to make training materials and maintain employee relation records.

7. Must have backup internet such as prepaid WiFi/data for stable remote working.

8. Must have a power backup in case of power outages.

9. Shift arrangement: Day shift for the first month, then transfer to night shift permanently.

10. Ability to speak and understand Chinese is a bonus qualification.



Application Guidelines

If you are interested in this position, please submit the following materials:

1. Your updated resume (resume link is acceptable).

2. Interested candidates please submit your application and fill out the questionnaire via the link below:

ue2fl6z2dmj.sg.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrlgzDguRc5jayVxeQLRnvW8Vc

Candidates who pass the initial screening will be contacted via email for an interview invitation. Wish you all the best.



Company Information

Company Website: www.drayeasy.com/



Company Benefits

We provide a stable working environment and clear career growth. Your professionalism and dedication will be highly valued. Candidates with Chinese skills enjoy better development opportunities and priority in recruitment. We are looking forward to your application!

description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Video Editor (YouTube and Shorts)
description:
Are you an experienced video editor who wants a stable, long-term role and the opportunity to help build a professional YouTube channel from the beginning?



I am creating a new YouTube channel focused on AI, business automation and digital enablement. The videos will demonstrate real automation projects, explain AI tools and workflows, and show businesses how technology can improve their operations.



This is not a channel built around generic stock footage and flashy transitions. The content needs to look polished, credible and professional because the channel will also represent my consulting and automation business.



1. Your Responsibilities:

You will be responsible for editing primarily long-form YouTube videos, with occasional short-form content.



Your work may include:

- Editing talking-head footage and screen recordings

- Creating clear motion graphics and visual explanations

- Illustrating workflows, systems, data flows and business processes

- Improving pacing and storytelling

- Cleaning and enhancing audio

- Adding appropriate music and sound design

- Creating professional YouTube thumbnails

- Repurposing selected content into Shorts when required



The videos will often be educational and technical. You should be able to make complicated topics easy to understand without making the editing feel childish or overly distracting.



2. What I’m Looking For

- Strong experience editing professional YouTube content

- Experience creating custom motion graphics for educational or business videos

- Good understanding of pacing, viewer retention and storytelling

- Strong attention to detail

- Experience editing screen recordings, software demonstrations or tutorials

- Good sound-design and audio-cleanup skills

- Experience creating thumbnails in Photoshop, Canva or similar tools

- No generic AI-generated thumbnails or low-effort AI visuals

- Reliable communication and the ability to meet agreed deadlines

- Willingness to receive feedback and improve over time



Experience with AI, automation, SaaS, technology or business content is helpful, but not required.



3. What You’ll Get

- A stable, long-term working relationship

- Consistent work

- Remote work with flexible hours

- Competitive compensation based on your skills and experience

- Clear feedback and communication

- Opportunities to take on more responsibility as the channel grows

- The chance to help shape the style of a new professional YouTube channel

title: E-commerce Management Accountant & Inventory Planner
description:
We are looking for a commercially minded accountant or finance professional to take ownership of our monthly profit and loss reporting, financial visibility, and inventory forecasting.



This is not simply a bookkeeping role.



We need someone who can keep our financial records accurate, clearly explain how the business is performing, and help us make better decisions around profitability, cash flow, stock levels, and future purchase orders.



The successful candidate will also be responsible for monitoring inventory across our product range and telling us exactly when new orders need to be placed, based on current sales, expected growth, manufacturing timelines, and shipping lead times.



We are a growing direct-to-consumer e-commerce business selling physical products in the United States.



## Key Responsibilities



### Monthly Financial Reporting



* Prepare and maintain an accurate monthly profit and loss statement.

* Reconcile revenue across Shopify, payment processors, subscriptions, refunds, and other sales channels.

* Track all major costs, including:



  * Product costs

  * Freight and shipping

  * Fulfilment and 3PL fees

  * Advertising spend

  * Payment processing fees

  * Software and agency costs

  * Refunds, chargebacks, and discounts

* Calculate gross profit, contribution margin, operating profit, and net profit.

* Review actual performance against forecasts and previous months.

* Identify unusual costs, margin changes, or areas where profitability is being lost.

* Produce a clear monthly financial report that management can understand and use to make decisions.

* Maintain accurate landed costs and cost of goods sold for each product.

* Support cash-flow forecasting and future payment planning.



### Inventory Management and Forecasting



* Maintain an accurate inventory tracker for all finished products, components, packaging, and incoming purchase orders.

* Monitor current sales velocity by product and SKU.

* Calculate weeks of stock remaining based on current and forecasted sales.

* Account for manufacturing time, ocean or air freight, customs, delivery to the warehouse, and safety stock.

* Provide clear reorder dates and recommended purchase-order quantities.

* Warn management early when a product is at risk of going out of stock or becoming overstocked.

* Model different sales scenarios, including expected growth, promotions, new product launches, and changes in advertising spend.

* Track purchase orders from placement through manufacturing, shipping, and warehouse delivery.

* Compare forecasted inventory usage against actual usage and update forecasts regularly.

* Help determine when air freight may be necessary and whether the additional cost is commercially justified.



## Monthly Deliverables



Each month, you will be expected to provide:



* A completed profit and loss statement.

* A cash-flow overview.

* Gross margin and contribution-margin reporting.

* A breakdown of major cost movements.

* Inventory levels by SKU.

* Current daily and monthly sales velocity.

* Estimated stock-out dates.

* Recommended purchase-order dates and quantities.

* A summary of financial or inventory risks that require management attention.



The information must be presented clearly. We do not want to receive spreadsheets without explanation. We want someone who can tell us what the numbers mean, what is changing, and what action we need to take.



## Required Experience



* Previous experience in accounting, management accounting, financial analysis, or commercial finance.

* Strong understanding of profit and loss statements, cost of goods sold, gross margin, cash flow, and inventory accounting.

* Experience working with an e-commerce or physical-product business.

* Experience forecasting inventory and calculating reorder points.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* High attention to detail and confidence working with large amounts of financial and operational data.

* Ability to communicate financial information in straightforward language.

* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of deadlines.



## Preferred Experience



* Experience with Shopify.

* Experience with subscription-based e-commerce businesses.

* Experience working with overseas manufacturers and international freight.

* Familiarity with 3PL and fulfilment reporting.

* Experience reconciling Shopify, payment processors, advertising platforms, and accounting software.

* Familiarity with tools such as QuickBooks, Xero, A2X, Triple Whale, Inventory Planner, or similar platforms.



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is proactive rather than reactive.



You should not wait for us to notice that stock is running low or that margins have fallen. You should identify the issue early, explain why it is happening, and recommend what we need to do next.



The right person will become a trusted financial and operational partner to the business—not simply someone who enters transactions into accounting software.



## Application Requirements



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief summary of your experience with e-commerce or physical-product businesses.

2. An example of how you have previously managed or reported monthly profit and loss.

3. Your experience forecasting inventory and calculating purchase-order dates.

4. The accounting, e-commerce, and inventory systems you have used.

5. Your availability and expected monthly rate.

6. A short explanation of how you would determine when a business needs to place its next inventory order.

title: Client Response and Outreach Coordinator - Australian Day Shift, 7:00am to 10:00am Manila, Monday to Friday
description:
$8.75 per hour. 15 hours per week guaranteed, up to 20 as required.



About us



Ready2Exit is Australia's leading SMB M&A advisory firm. We help business owners sell the companies they have spent twenty or thirty years building, and we help buyers acquire them properly. Most of the people we deal with are owner operators in trades, manufacturing and services, and for almost all of them, selling their business is the largest financial decision they will ever make.



I am Stuart Earl, Investor, M&A Advisor and leader of Australia's largest business marketplace with over 180,000 members. 



We are a lean tea
aning you will work directly with me every day. What you do will show up directly in whether this business grows, and you will be able to watch that happen rather than take my word for it.



What we care about

Most business owners only sell a business once in their life. The industry does not serve them well, and the complaints are always the same: overpromising, no transparency, and no real buyer engagement. We built Ready2Exit to fix that, through preparation, honesty and doing the work properly.



Three things matter here more than anything else, and they will shape your day.



The first is speed. When a business owner calls us back, they are d
 in that 
nt whether we are serious people. A response forty five minutes later answers that question for them, and not in our favour.

The second is precision. Details are not administration in this business. A wrong figure in a follow up
 can cost us a mandate that took months to win.

The third is honesty, and that includes honesty upwards. If I have made a mistake, I would rather hear it from you on the day than find it myself a fortnight later. The same applies in the other direction, and I will tell you directly when something is not right. Most people prefer working that way once they get used to it.



The role

You will own the front line of our communication, in both directions.



On one side, we run outreach campaigns and paid advertising that generate inbound calls, replies and form submissions. Those currently sit too long before anyone answers them, and it is the single biggest gap in our week. Closing that gap is the main reason this role exists.



On the other side, when we take on a business to sell, we build a list of buyers who might be a fit and we call them. That outbound work is yours as well. It is not cold selling. It is ringing people who are actively looking to buy a business and telling them we have something worth a conversation.



Either way, you are the first person from Ready2Exit that a buyer or a business owner ever speaks to. That is not an administrative job, and I do not intend to treat it as one.



What you will be responsible for



The list below is in priority order, and the order genuinely matters. When two things compete, the one higher up wins. You will never need to ask my permission to drop something for an inbound call.



Inbound response. Every call, reply and form submission that comes from our campaigns. Qualify it against criteria I will give you, then book it, route it or close it out. Log every single one. You own that contact from the first touch through to a booked appointment.



Outbound buyer outreach. When we have a business on the market, you will work through a buyer list by phone and
, introduce the opportunity, and book the ones who are interested.



Callbacks and appointment booking. Returning missed calls and managing my diary around them.



Follow up. Post pitch follow up by
 and phone, on a cadence that you own and run without me reminding you, plus a weekly sweep of the pipeline for anything that has gone quiet.



Scheduling and rescheduling. Multi party, across time zones, with nothing dropped.



Administration. Onboarding
s and forms, and setting up document folders and permissions for live deals.



The standard



We are a high performance team and we thrive on overdelivering for our clients.



Fifteen minutes is the response time inside your window. We will measure it, and it will be your key measure of success.

Some mornings a campaign goes out and inbound will take your entire window. Other mornings it will be quiet and you will work through the background list. Both of those are normal and neither is a problem.



Outside your window we are honestly uncovered. Automation acknowledges people and you call them at the start of the next morning. We do not pretend to be larger than we are.



Who I am looking for



You have worked somewhere the phone was the revenue. That might be a medical or dental front desk, service dispatch, roadside assistance, insurance claims intake, hotel reservations, client services at a broking firm, or an inbound queue with a target on the wall. What matters is that you have done this under a clock rather than at your own pace.



You will know the specific feeling of being halfway through careful work when something urgent lands. You can deal with the urgent thing, log it properly before you move on, and then go back and finish the careful work without breaking it. Most people manage two of those three. If you can do all three reliably, you are the person I want to talk to.



Your English needs to be strong in both directions. You will be speaking with Australian owner operators in trades, manufacturing and services, and they will hang up if following you takes effort. You will also be writing
s that go out under my name into live deals, so your written English needs to be good enough that I can send it as it is.



You should get a kick out of a fast moving environment where things change without much warning. Some mornings the plan lasts ten minutes before a campaign lands or a deal moves. If that reads as chaos to you, this will not suit. If it reads as a good morning, we should talk. The people who do well here are the ones who are comfortable in the unknown and would rather work something out than wait to be told.



Beyond that, I am looking for someone who is genuinely detail obsessed, to the point of finding the error nobody told you was there. Someone who can be given an outcome rather than a method and work out the rest without needing to be walked through it. Someone who does not need me standing behind them. And someone with mature confidence, by which I mean you will tell me when you think I am wrong, once, with your reasoning, and then get on with the decision either way.

What you get



The rate is $8.75 USD per hour, with 15 hours guaranteed and up to 20 hours in weeks where the volume requires it, at the same rate. You are also paid 13th month.



On growth, I will be straight with you rather than make a promise I cannot stand behind. Our volume is increasing and my intention is to take this role to 30 hours or more within three months. That will happen when the workload supports it and when you have shown you can hold the standard, not on a fixed date I invent now to make this advertisement more attractive. If both of those things are true, the hours are there and the path to full time is real.



You will work directly with me, with no layers in between. You will get proper training, and you will learn how business acquisitions actually work, which is exposure that very few people in this market ever get. You will also be trusted with confidential financial information and live deals from early on, because there is no version of this job where you are kept at arm's length from the real work.



Nice to have, though not required

Experience with GoHighLevel, SharePoint or OneDrive, exposure to Australian clients, or a background in professional services or finance.



How to apply

Please read this section properly. A large number of applications will be set aside for missing a step, and that is deliberate.

1. Begin your application with the word DISPATCH.

2. Then answer these three questions, briefly:



- What was your response time target in your last role, and what happened when you missed it?

- Tell me about the last time something urgent interrupted you mid task. What happened to the work you were in the middle of?

- What is your internet speed, and what do you do when it drops out?



3. Record a video of one to two minutes and include the link. An unlisted YouTube video, a Loom or a Google Drive link are all fine. Speak to camera and tell me why this role interests you, why you are the right fit for it, and what makes you the standout candidate.



Please do not script it. I want to hear you think. A polished read tells me nothing about how you will sound on a live call with an Australian business owner, and that is the part of the job I actually need to assess.



Attach your CV.



Stuart Earl

M&A Advisor | Founder, Ready2Exit

Australia's leading SMB M&A Advisory Firm

title: Remote Survey Programmer — Voxco / JavaScript Specialist (Market Research)
description:
Remote Survey Programmer — Voxco / JavaScript Specialist (Market Research)

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent (approx. 40 hrs/week)



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a Survey Programmer to join us on a long-term contract basis. This is a real partnership, not a transactional gig — and a chance to contribute to something genuinely new in market research. The package reflects that:



• Front-row seat on a voicebot R&D project — you’ll contribute directly to a survey voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Real conversational-AI exposure on your CV.



• Base retainer: ?90,000 – ?140,000 PHP per month, commensurate with experience and voicebot project involvement, paid in arrears.



• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.



• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing platform training (Voxco and related tools) so you can perform at the highest level.



• Direct relationship with senior project managers in Australia/New Zealand — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We’re looking for a Survey Programmer who can take complex questionnaires and turn them into clean, well-tested, production-ready survey scripts. You’ll own the scripting pipeline end-to-end: build, test, launch, deliver data.



Direct experience with Voxco is ideal, but we’re equally open to strong programmers from Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics who can pick up Voxco quickly — and we’ll fund the training to get you there. What matters more is that you can write real JavaScript (not just drag-and-drop survey builder logic) and that you sweat the details on QA.



The Voicebot Project — What Makes This Different



Alongside your core scripting work, you’ll contribute to something most survey programmers never get to touch: TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that conducts genuine, natural-sounding interviews at scale.



Your role on the project: building the underlying survey logic, question structures, routing, and validation rules that the voicebot will run. You’re not expected to be an ML engineer — you’re the survey expert who makes sure the conversational layer asks the right questions in the right order and captures clean data on the other side.



This is genuine R&D work with commercial backing. You’ll be one of a handful of survey programmers globally with hands-on conversational-AI experience on your CV.



What You’ll Do

• Translate questionnaires (Word, PDF, client-supplied) into interactive online and CATI scripts.

• Build complex logic: skip patterns, routing, piping, randomisation, quota management, custom validations.

• Write JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 to extend platform functionality where the out-of-the-box tools fall short.

• Test thoroughly — logic, edge cases, mobile rendering, accessibility — before anything goes live.

• Export and format data (SPSS, CSV, Excel) for the analysis team.



What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years programming surveys in a market research agency, fieldwork house, or specialised BPO.

• Strong JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 — you should be comfortable debugging in browser dev tools.

• Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise platform: Voxco, Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics.

• Bonus points for SPSS syntax, Python, SQL, or experience with conjoint/MaxDiff modules.

• Genuine interest in conversational AI — you don’t need ML experience, but you should be curious about how survey methodology and voice AI intersect.

• Reliable home office: high-spec PC, dual monitors preferred, stable internet plus a backup option.

• Strong written English — you’ll be communicating with project managers in Australia and New Zealand.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The platforms you’ve worked on.

2. The most complex script you’ve built.

3. Your earliest available start date.

4. A sentence or two on why the voicebot project interests you.

?

Relevant certifications may include HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, Zapier, Make, n8n, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, CRM administration, automation, data, or other closely related GTM systems certifications.

- Convert an unclear business problem into a technical implementation plan

- Scope projects accurately

- Build reliable systems with minimal supervision

- Identify dependencies and edge cases before launch

- Test, deploy, monitor, and maintain workflows

- Produce clear client-facing documentation

- Communicate directly with clients

- Manage multiple client environments

- Flag technical risks and scope issues early

- Deliver systems that solve real business problems

title: Comedy Short-Form Video Editor – Clip Funny Videos for TikTok/Reels/Shorts (CapCut)
description:
I have a 15-minute comedy short film, and I'm looking for ONE talented editor to turn it into viral short-form clips and post them consistently to Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



THE GOAL OF EVERY CLIP: make people want to watch the FULL film on YouTube. Each clip should be funny on its own, but leave viewers curious - with a caption and call-to-action pointing them to the full video.



WHAT MAKES THIS JOB DIFFERENT: I'm not looking for a "clean" corporate editor. I'm looking for someone who understands COMEDY - someone who knows where the laugh is, cuts to the punchline fast, and makes clips that feel native to TikTok, not like ads.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Watch my short film and identify the funniest, most clippable moments

- Edit 4-6 vertical (9:16) clips per week using CapCut or Premiere

- Add captions/subtitles, sound design, and meme-style text where it fits

- Post clips to Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts on a consistent schedule (you'll help set up a new TikTok account; Instagram and YouTube access provided through business/scheduling tools)

- Potentially set up and run 1-2 additional "clip page" style accounts posting clips of the film, so discovery feels organic

- Write short, punchy captions with a consistent call-to-action driving viewers to the full film on YouTube

- Send me a simple weekly recap: what was posted, views, what's working



DELIVERABLES (PER CLIP):

- Vertical 9:16 format, optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

- All content sourced from existing footage I provide (no need to shoot anything)

- Each clip should feel editor-led and organic - like a fan or meme page clipped it, NOT like a movie trailer or an ad

title: Part-Time B2B Appointment Setter for a US Software Company (Night Shift, $8/hr + Bonus)
description:
We are a US-based software company. We build custom internal tools for small US businesses, and we are looking for one experienced part-time appointment setter to cold call US business owners and book them into a 30-minute discovery call with our team. You set the meeting and gather a little information about the company and the prospect. You do not pitch pricing, demo, or close.



This is a long-term role. We want the same person for 12 or more months.



COMPENSATION

- $8.00 per hour base, paid weekly

- $25 bonus for every qualified meeting that shows up on our calendar

- Realistic monthly earnings: $800 to $1,050 for 20 hours per week

- Paid in USD



SCHEDULE

- 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday (20 hours per week)

- You call during US Central business hours, which is a night shift here, roughly 10 PM to 2 AM Philippine time

- Only apply if you are comfortable working nights on an ongoing basis



WHAT YOU WILL DO

This is not a heavy-admin role. Our software does the boring work so you can spend your hours on conversations.

- Call US business owners using our own CRM power dialer. Target: 130 to 150 dials per day

- Before each dial, your screen shows the prospect, their likely problem, and a script written for that specific company. There is no one universal pitch. The system tells you who they are, what to say, and even the voi
 lines. You are never guessing

- Qualify the prospect, then book qualified prospects onto our calendar

- Our team runs the discovery call from there



What you do NOT do:

- No lead research (we give you the list, already built)

- No CRM data entry (the system logs every call for you)

- No pitching, quoting, or closing



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven US-market B2B cold calling experience (2+ years, ideally 4+)

- You have called business owners, not consumers

- Clear, professional English, C1 or C2 level. Neutral accent strongly preferred

- Your own laptop and a quality USB headset

- Reliable fiber or fast internet, quiet workspace

- Comfortable with a 4-hour call block



DO NOT APPLY IF

- You have never cold called US business owners

- Your English is heavily accented or conversational only

- You can only work Philippine daytime hours

- You are an agency or a team. We hire one freelancer



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully)

Apply here through OnlineJobs.ph. In your application, include all four of these, or we will not review it:



1. The code word from this post, in all caps: QUIX. This confirms you read the post.



2. Your single best cold-calling month, numbers only: total dials, meetings booked, and show rate.



3. A link to a 60-second video or audio recording of yourself. In it, pretend you are cold calling Jim, the owner of a 25-person manufacturing company in Ohio. The problem on your screen is: "Still building quotes in spreadsheets?" Make it sound like a real call, the way you would actually say it. Upload to Google Drive, Loom, or Vocaroo and paste the link.



4. Confirmation that you can work night shift long term.



We review every application that includes all four items and reply to the ones that pass our first screen. Shortlisted applicants move to a short online assessment, then an interview.

The DTC ad industry is broken.

The only thing standing between us and that number is creative volume. Which is exactly why this role exists.





WHO YOU'LL BE



You'll be the first dedicated AI ad creator on our team.



Not an editor. Not a video guy. A creator — someone who takes a script or a hook brief and produces launch-ready ads from A to Z, using the most powerful AI stack on the planet.



Every ad you ship will run against Gymshark, Ridge, Manscaped, Hexclad, Skims. And your job is to make ours better than theirs.



This isn't a support role. This is the role that fuels the next $50M of revenue.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Two workflows fill your week:



1. NET-NEW ADS (script ? launch-ready ad)

We hand you a script. You handle everything else:

- Break it into shots

2. HOOK ITERATIONS (winner ? variants that HIT HARDER)

We hand you a hook brief on a scaling ad. Your job:

- Generate variants that outperform the original

- Understand the science of what stops a scroll

- Ship 10 versions ready to plug into a validated body + CTA



The hook is the highest-leverage variable in modern advertising. If you master it here, you'll be one of the most valuable creatives in the industry within 12 months.





WHAT YOU GET (this isn't a job — it's a launchpad)



- Base salary: $
USD/month depending on portfolio

- UNCAPPED BONUS: $100 every time one of your ads hits $10K in spend. Some ads hit $50-100K+. There is no cap. Ever. Top creatives on our team pull an extra $
/month in bonuses alone.

- Paid via Wise, bi-monthly (1st & 15th). Always on time. Never missed.

- Paid vacation + Philippine holidays + 13th month + yearly performance raises

- Full access to the best AI training on the market — every course, every mentorship, every community we can find. We buy them all. You get them all. Day 1.

- Access to 30+ proprietary skills we built for hook-swap, UGC mashup, video-to-static, iteration-playbook — internal IP no other team has.



You will 10x your craft in 6 months here. And I mean that literally. Two current tea
mbers have already done it.





THE GROWTH PATH



- Months 1-3: You execute. Ship ads. Master the stack.

- Months 4-6: You write your own hooks. Iterate autonomously. Suggest angles.

- Months 7-12: You transition into Creative Strategist — reading ROAS/hook rate/hold rate/CPA, diagnosing winners, writing briefs, running iteration playbooks. Salary jumps to $
/month + bonuses.

- Year 2: You're managing your own AI creator(s). You're a Creative Director. Salary ceiling: $
/month + bonuses.



This isn't hypothetical. This is the path we've already run twice.



If you're a real crack, you won't be a video creator in 18 months. You'll be running a team.





HOW WE WORK



- Semi-async

- 15-min daily check-in (camera on)

- 40h/week, minimum 4h overlap with European time (CET)

- Ship fast beats polish forever. A live ad today beats a perfect ad next week.





YOU MUST HAVE

- Real hands-on experience generating AI video (Higgsfield, Kie.ai, Runway, Veo, Sora, Wan, Kling — pick at least one)

- Hunger to become one of the best AI ad creators in the world





BONUS SKILLS (= higher starting salary)

- ffmpeg command line

- ElevenLabs voice cloning + directing

- Direct-response copywriting knowledge (name a book you've read in your application)

- Static ad production (Photoshop / Figma / Higgsfield)





NON-NEGOTIABLE



This is your ONLY client. Full-time. Exclusive.



No side agencies. No parallel full-time contracts. No moonlighting.



We invest heavily in you — premium training, top stack, direct founder access, path to Creative Director. In return, we get your full brain, every day.



If you're planning to juggle 3 clients "on the side" — this is not the role for you and we will find out fast.





TRIAL

HOW TO APPLY

A LAST NOTE



If you're an average editor looking for a comfortable remote gig — you'll hate it here. We ship fast, review honestly, and expect you to grow every single month.



But if you're the kind of person who reads job posts like this one at 11pm and thinks "this is finally the opportunity I've been waiting for" — hit apply. Let's build something historic.

title: Program Administrator - Australian Educational Travel Company (EA's and PA's encouraged to apply)
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION



Students Explore Australia Pty Ltd (trading as Access Adventure Club) is on a mission to connect young people with nature, to improve the wellbeing of our next generation. We predominantly achieve this through delivering our Accessible Adventures programs for young people with disabilities.



We have been in operation for 10 years and are leaders in a uniquely positioned niche that falls between outdoor education, disability support and tourism in Australia. We currently have a team of 15 full time staff and approximately 60 casual staff.



Our core values are:

1. We resonate good vibes

2. We are hungry to contribute the company’s purpose

3. We are highly organised and disciplined

4. We are adaptable to change

5. We are optimists, with can-do attitudes

6. Challenge is an opportunity for personal growth





ROLE DESCRIPTION



In this role, you will be a powerhouse administrator that enables our programs to be executed smoothly. This directly impacts how many students we can connect with nature, and the quality of those connections. The role can be summed up into 3 major components:



- Providing administrative assistance to help delivery of our Acessible Adventures Camp programs (80%) and School Camp Programs (if applicable) (10%)



- Business-specific administration that ensures the continual running of the company (10%)



All training will be provided, and specific tasks will include things such as:



- Creating program delivery timelines and participant registration forms in Asana and our CRM (GHL)

- Liaising with third-party providers such as accommodations and activity providers to book their services and check availability.

- Communicating with internal staff to help allocate them to programs

- Creating the timings for itineraries using google maps

- Adding third party provider information to our growing database

- Working with Asana project management software to collaborate with tea
mbers on program-specific tasks

- Making sure our google drive folders are organised and have the right information in them.

- Helping to document and organise operating procedures (Documentation & video screen recording)

- Participating in weekly tea
etings and create reports





The Ideal Candidate will be:



- Have a high level of critical thinking and ability to make good decisions

- Extremely organised – almost obsessively organised

- Have 5 years or more experience as an Executive Assistant or Personal Assistant, preferably with an Australian company, OR;

- have 5 years or more experience as a senior administrator (with references)

- Proficient in the Microsoft Office suite of programs and G-Suite Programs

- A highly skilled communicator 

- Process orientated, and a systematic thinker

- A rigorous advocate for our core values

- Highly detail oriented, with an eye for finding small errors



Other Requirements:



- Stable internet connection with a minimum standard of 20 mbps download / 5 mbps upload

- Life-long learner with a thirst for knowledge

- Ability to understand complex business processes and requirements

- Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively as part of a team

- Knowledge about travel or education preferred but not necessary



The role is permanent fulltime. Our head office is located in Everard Park, South Australia 5035, and we work in the Adelaide time zone, which is 6:30am – 3:30pm in the Philippines. We welcome applicants who prefer to work from home, office or a combination of both.



WHY WORK WITH US:



- Australian Day Shift - 6:30am to 3:30pm PH Time

- We have an extremely strong culture built upon our core values, that focuses on our staff wellbeing, including company meditation on Monday and Friday, staff recognition and an optional staff professional development plan.

- We meet once per year in person for a 1 week team retreat (all expenses paid) - focusing on business planning and leadership training (last one was May 2026 in Bali)

- Salary (paid twice a month): Php 60,000 – Php 80,000 (depending on qualifications and experience)

- 13th-month Pay as an addition to your base salary

- Monthly Contributions to SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG, as an addition to base salary

- 20 Annual Leave Credits

- Paid public holiday days off (based on South Australian calendar) - additional to leave credits

- Training and other career development opportunities

- Stable and growing company

- Long-term/full-time job opportunity

- Birthday, Christmas and Work Anniversary Gifts

- HMO paid for, with MaxiCare or another provider (again, as an addition to base salary).



HOW TO APPLY:



This opportunity is not for you, if you do not meet the above-mentioned job requirements. However, if you believe you are the powerhouse administrator that our students deserve, then please send us the 2 following things:



1. link of your updated resume (both in MS Word and PDF formats) and make your pitch in your resume headline!



2. A link to a two-minute video introduction sharing to us your hobbies outside work and your favorite AI tool that you have used in the past.



TAKE NOTE: You will only be contacted if you have met the above requirements and included both your resume and video.

title: Full-Time Project Coordinator / Experienced Administrative Assistant for Cabinet Dealership (Construction)
description:
Job Description

We are a cabinet dealership in Vero Beach, Florida specializing in kitchens and baths. We already have a talented design assistant in the Philippines who creates drawings, elevations, renderings, and pricing. You will work closely with her as part of our small, established Philippine team. We are now looking for a second, highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to serve as Project Coordinator / Administrative Assistant. Your focus will be the “back-end” of projects, so everything is accurate, organized, and ready for ordering, delivery, and installation. 



Core Responsibilities

• Review order materials / bill of materials against final elevations and drawings for accuracy (this includes cabinets and aftermarket items)



• Enter, review and correct materials in online cabinet ordering programs / bill of materials against final elevations and drawings for accuracy (this includes cabinets and aftermarket items)



• Prepare and type up professional quotes for final review



• Create project management folders (digital) for each job when it is ready for delivery and installation (this includes job information, appliance information, final elevations and layouts, hardware layouts with notes, etc.)



• Create hardware counts and add clear notes on the final elevations for client approval



• Request and log countertop quotes for every job



• Maintain an accurate delivery schedule



• Keep a detailed warranty log



• Organize and maintain all digital project files (elevations, quotes, approvals, photos, etc.)

Additional helpful tasks (we will train you)



• Track purchase orders and material lead times



• Prepare simple installation packets for the crew (elevations + hardware lists + notes)



• Follow up on client approvals and change orders



• Update project status trackers



• Assist with basic supplier communication and inventory notes



• Maintain simple reports on upcoming deliveries and open warranties



• Other administrative support as the business grows 



Schedule

Full-time (approximately 40 hours/week).

You must be available and online during our core overlap hours: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM Eastern Time (Florida time), Monday–Friday.

(That is 9:00 PM – 12:00 AM Philippine time.)

The remaining hours of your workday can be done before or after this window — whatever works best for you.

Time Tracking

We use TimeProof (the free built-in tracker from OnlineJobs.ph) to record work hours and occasional screenshots. This helps us confirm availability during the required core hours and keeps everything transparent for both of us. The tracker is simple to install and is standard for many remote roles.



Requirements

• Excellent written and spoken English



• Strong attention to detail (this is critical — you will be checking drawings, elevations, and counts)



• Highly organized and able to create clean digital file systems (Google Drive experience)



• Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive) and/or Microsoft Office



• Comfortable working with PDFs, elevations, and basic drawings (no design experience required — our other assistant handles the design work)



• Previous experience in construction, remodeling, kitchen & bath design, cabinets, interior design, or manufacturing is wanted and strongly preferred



• Reliable, computer, internet and quiet workspace



• Able to work independently and communicate clearly with a small team. Compensation

$800 – $1,000 USD per month depending on experience and skills (full-time).



We pay via Wise.

We start with weekly payments for the first 1–2 months to build trust, then switch to bi-weekly or monthly. We value long-term relationships and give performance-based raises. 

To Apply

Please send: 

1. Your resume / OnlineJobs.ph profile 

2. A short paragraph telling us why this role interests you and briefly highlighting any construction, kitchen & bath, or related experience 

3. Your expected monthly salary 

4. Confirmation that you can work the required 9 AM–12 PM ET core hours

As part of the hiring process, we will ask finalists to complete a short paid test task (reviewing sample elevations, layout, renderings, and materials list). We look forward to meeting organized, detail-oriented people with relevant experience who want a stable, long-term role supporting a growing American cabinet business.

**Hours (please read):** This is a support role for the editing team, so it does not require a full graveyard shift. We need a few hours of daily overlap with US Pacific business time (roughly 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM PT) for briefs, feedback, and revisions — you tell us the window you can hold. Please only apply if you can commit to that overlap consistently long-term.



We're an early, fast-moving team, so the scope of this role will grow over time. It suits someone who wants more on their plate, picks up new formats without waiting for perfect instructions, and treats being handed more responsibility as the point, not the burden.



**What you'll do:**

- Cut short-form clips (Reels / TikTok / Shorts) from long-form footage with captions, hooks, and clean pacing

- Clip podcast episodes into shareable segments

- Assemble and polish longer-form and narrative "movie-style" edits

- Handle the finishing pass: sync, color, audio cleanup, titles, and simple motion graphics

- Turn revisions around quickly and keep project files and exports organized

- Work from briefs and match the style or reference each project calls for



**Must-haves:**

- 2+ years editing across both short-form and long-form / narrative work

- Fluent in Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a plus)

- A reel or samples showing clips **and** a longer edit

title: Performance Video Editor - Ecommerce Meta Ads | Full-Time | Long-Term
description:
Build Meta ads that make people stop, watch and buy



We are a growing UK-based portfolio of direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands. Paid creative is one of our most important growth levers, and we are hiring a genuinely performance-minded video editor to become a long-term member of our creative team.



This is not a general social-media editing role. We are not looking for cinematic montages, podcast clips or someone who simply follows a shot list. We need an editor who understands the job of a Meta ad: earn attention, make the message easy to follow, create desire and move the viewer toward action.



What you will own



- Turn creative briefs, scripts, UGC, product footage, reviews and sourced material into mobile-first Meta ads.

- Create UGC, voiceover/B-roll, testimonial, problem-solution, product-demo, founder-style and mini-VSL edits.

- Build purposeful hook variants and iterations from performance feedback rather than making cosmetic changes.

- Improve pacing, visual hierarchy, captions, sound design, pattern interrupts and proof so each second earns the next.

- Source or generate suitable B-roll and supporting visuals, while keeping an auditable source list and respecting usage rights.

- Check every edit against the product facts, landing page, offer and brand standards; flag any mismatch or unsupported claim before delivery.

- Study winners, losers, competitors and customer language; create original iterations and bring clear editing hypotheses back to the creative team.

- Keep current with Meta ad policies and delivery specifications, and escalate compliance risk rather than guessing.

- Keep projects, assets, versions and exports impeccably organised and flag blockers early.

- Respond to feedback quickly, explain your choices calmly and improve the work without ego.



What excellent looks like



- You can explain exactly why the first three seconds should stop the right customer - not just say a hook is 'engaging'.

- You understand the difference between hook/thumb-stop rate, hold/retention, CTR, CVR and ROAS, including what editing can and cannot influence.

- Your visual choices clarify the sales message. Effects serve the idea; they never become the idea.

- You can make strong work from imperfect or limited source material and propose practical alternatives when an asset is missing.

- You learn from performance data and feedback, then turn one insight into several meaningfully different tests.

- You are reliable in an async team: clear updates, realistic deadlines, clean handoffs and no disappearing when something is difficult.



Required evidence



- A portfolio containing real ecommerce or direct-response paid ads. Generic showreels are not enough.

- Strong command of a professional editing workflow such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut Desktop.

- Hands-on experience with UGC and B-roll-led ads, captions, sound design and mobile-first 9:16 delivery.

- Good written English, dependable internet, an editing-capable computer and a realistic backup plan for outages.

- Full-time availability and the desire to build depth with one long-term team. Existing commitments must be disclosed.



Useful but not mandatory



- Experience with AI video, AI UGC, voice generation or enhancement tools such as Runway, Kling, HeyGen, Arcads, ElevenLabs or equivalent.

- Experience reviewing Meta creative performance or working closely with a media buyer or creative strategist.

- Light motion-graphics capability and confidence adapting creative for different placements, offers or audiences.



What we offer



- $1,200-$1,600 USD per month, based on relevant evidence and paid-test performance.

- A stable, full-time, long-term role with flexible working hours and sensible UK/Philippines collaboration windows.

- Clear briefs, access to tools and assets, direct performance feedback and structured creative coaching.

- Paid leave, a pro-rated 13th-month benefit, skills-development support and a clearly defined, capped performance bonus after the ramp period.

- A fully paid one-month mutual ramp period with a written day-30 review; there is no reduced trainee rate.

- A genuine path toward Senior Editor or Creative Lead as judgement, performance and ownership grow.

- A paid practical test for shortlisted candidates. We do not ask applicants for hours of free production work.



How to apply - follow every step



Use the subject line: META BUILDER | [your first name]



Begin the first line of your message with: I optimise for the sale, not the showreel.



Then answer the questions below in order. Keep the whole application concise. Do not send a portfolio dump.



1. Share exactly three ecommerce/direct-response ads that best represent you. For each: product/category, ad format, what you personally owned, and the public or unlisted link.

2. For each ad, share any performance context you are genuinely allowed to disclose. If you were not given spend or results, write 'not shared' and explain what feedback or iteration signal you did receive.

3. Choose the strongest of those three ads. Why should its first three seconds work for the intended buyer, and what exact edit would you improve today? Maximum 120 words.

4. Scenario: an ad has a strong hook rate but weak CTR. What three editing hypotheses would you test next, and why? Maximum 150 words.

5. List the editing and AI tools you have used on real client work. Separate advanced, working and learning-level tools.

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD, earliest start date and full-time availability? Disclose any current job, retainer or ongoing freelance commitment.

7. What computer do you edit on, what is your usual internet speed, and what is your backup plan for electricity or internet failure?

8. If shortlisted, can you complete a paid, standardised 2-3 hour editing test within a 48-hour window?



Automatic disqualifiers: Missing the subject/first-line instruction; no relevant ecommerce ads; unclear ownership of portfolio work; copied claims presented as personal work; undisclosed conflicting full-time employment; or unwillingness to complete the paid test.

title: Senior Geological Consultant
description:
Senior Geological Consultant





Job Summary

The Senior Geological Consultant provides technical advice and supervision for mineral exploration activities. The position is responsible for geological mapping, exploration planning, drill-hole design, core logging, sampling, resource estimation, geological modeling, and technical report preparation.



Duties and Responsibilities

?Plan and supervise mineral exploration activities.

?Conduct geological mapping, field verification, and structural interpretation.

?Identify and evaluate possible mineralized areas and exploration targets.

?Prepare drill-hole, trenching, and sampling programs.

?Coordinate with drilling teams regarding drill-hole locations, depths, and geological targets.

?Supervise drill-core logging, sampling, core recovery, and geological data recording.

?Interpret geological, geochemical, drilling, and remote-sensing data.

?Use portable XRF and other field equipment for mineral identification and analysis.

?Prepare geological maps, cross-sections, borehole logs, and technical drawings.

?Develop three-dimensional orebody models.

?Conduct mineral resource and reserve estimation.

?Analyze deposit types, ore controls, mineralization, and metallogenic patterns.

?Review exploration results and recommend additional exploration work.

?Prepare and review geological reports, resource reports, and technical documents.

?Ensure the accuracy and proper storage of geological data.

?Lead and train geologists and field personnel.

?Coordinate with project managers, engineers, drilling contractors, and technical teams.

?Ensure compliance with approved exploration programs, safety requirements, and environmental standards.

?Perform other geological duties assigned by management.



Qualifications

?Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Resource Exploration, or a related field.

?Master’s degree in Geological Engineering or a related field is preferred.

?At least 20 years of experience in mineral exploration and geological project management.

?Experience in gold, copper, silver, lead-zinc, iron, rare earth, and other mineral deposits.

?Strong experience in geological mapping, drill-core logging, sampling, and exploration planning.

?Experience in mineral resource and reserve estimation.

?Knowledge of three-dimensional geological and orebody modeling.

?Experience in preparing technical reports and mineral exploration documents.

?Experience in leading geological teams and managing large exploration projects.

?Senior Geological Engineer certification or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

?Mandarin language proficiency is preferred for technical coordination with the stakeholders.



Required Competencies

?Mineral exploration planning and target identification

?Geological and structural mapping

?Drill-hole and trenching program design

?Drill-core logging and core recovery control

?Geological sampling and quality control

?Geological, geochemical, and remote-sensing data interpretation

?Portable XRF operation and field mineral analysis

?Orebody identification and mineralization interpretation

?Three-dimensional geological and orebody modeling

?Mineral resource and reserve estimation

?Kriging and inverse-distance estimation methods

?Metallogenic analysis and prospecting-model development

?Geological map, cross-section, and borehole-log preparation

?MAPGIS, 3DMine, AutoCAD, and Surfer software

?Technical report preparation and document review

?Geological database and spatial-data management

?Exploration project planning and technical risk control

?Geological team leadership and technical training

?Environmental site investigation and rehabilitation knowledge

?Strong technical analysis and problem-solving skills

title: Principal Drilling Consultant
description:
Principal Drilling Consultant



The Principal Drilling Consultant provides overall technical guidance and supervision for mineral exploration drilling activities. The position is responsible for improving drilling performance, solving complex drilling problems, managing drilling teams, and ensuring safe and efficient operations.



Duties and Responsibilities

?Provide technical advice for mineral exploration drilling operations.

?Plan and recommend suitable drilling methods, equipment, and drilling programs.

?Supervise mechanical, full-hydraulic, crawler-mounted, and portable hydraulic drilling rigs.

?Solve complex drilling problems such as hole collapse, stuck rods, lost circulation, broken formations, and quicksand layers.

?Develop and control drilling mud for unstable and fractured ground conditions.

?Monitor drilling progress, core recovery, equipment performance, safety, and project costs.

?Lead and supervise drilling supervisors, drillers, mechanics, and field personnel.

?Train drilling personnel on proper equipment operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and safety procedures.

?Coordinate with geologists, project managers, contractors, logistics teams, and local workers.

?Review drilling plans, daily reports, equipment records, and technical performance.

?Conduct equipment inspections, preventive maintenance, fault diagnosis, and minor repairs.

?Ensure compliance with company safety, environmental, and government requirements.

?Recommend improvements to drilling procedures, equipment use, manpower, and cost control.

?Perform other drilling-related duties assigned by management.



Qualifications

?At least 25 years of experience in mineral exploration drilling.

?Extensive experience in drilling supervision and project management.

?Strong knowledge of mechanical and full-hydraulic drilling equipment.

?Experience in operating and maintaining full-hydraulic / crawler-mounted drilling equipment.

?Experience in complex, fractured, unstable, weathered, and quicksand formations.

?Strong knowledge of drilling mud preparation, hole stabilization, and drilling troubleshooting.

?Experience in equipment maintenance, hydraulic systems, and fault diagnosis.

?Proven ability to lead, train, and manage drilling teams.

?Strong knowledge of drilling safety and field risk management.

?Experience in remote and overseas mineral exploration projects.

?Strong knowledge of international drilling safety standards and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) management practices.

?Advanced mineral exploration drilling knowledge
